About Australian Olympic Committee
----------------------------------

The AOC is committed to developing, promoting and protecting the principles of Olympism and the Olympic Movement in Australia in accordance with the Olympic Charter.  
  
The AOC is committed to Australia's athletes and encourages the development of high performance sport through athlete support and funding initiatives. It is our responsibility to select, send and fund Australian Teams to the Olympic Summer and Winter Games, Youth Olympic Games and Regional Games.  
  
The AOC aims to promote, raise awareness of and encourage participation in sport for benefits of health, longevity, fitness, skill, achievement, social interaction, wellbeing and other benefits of exercise for all individuals in Australia. The AOC is dedicated to the education of Australia's youth and runs a number of programs through all levels of school, including the Olympics Unleashed program and the Australian Olympic Change-Maker program.  
  
The AOC is a non-profit organisation, independent of Government and Government funding other than contributions by State Governments to the Olympic Team Appeal. The AOC is an Incorporated Association whose members are the national bodies of sports on the Olympic program. State Olympic Councils represent the AOC in every State and Territory.

About Rowville Secondary College
--------------------------------

Rowville Secondary College, located at Paratea Dr, Rowville, Victoria, has been a cornerstone of educational excellence since its establishment in 1990. Initially welcoming around 180 students in years 7 and 8, the college has since expanded significantly, now serving over 1,800 students across two dynamic campuses. The Western Campus offers a comprehensive General Excellence program for students in years 7 to 12 and is home to the esteemed Maths and Science Academy (MSA), which fosters a deep understanding of STEM subjects. Meanwhile, the Eastern Campus, inaugurated in 1996, focuses on years 7 to 9, providing specialized programs for General Excellence, the Sports Academy (RSA), and the Institute of Arts (RIA).  
  
At Rowville Secondary College, the mission is clear: to equip students with the essential skills needed to thrive in Australian society. The dedicated staff work collaboratively with parents and the community to create vibrant, challenging, and engaging educational experiences. This commitment to excellence is reflected in the diverse range of programs that cater to various interests and talents, ensuring that every student can achieve their personal best. For those interested in the teaching staff, a comprehensive Rowville Secondary College teachers list is available on the college's website, showcasing the experienced educators who are passionate about nurturing the next generation. With a focus on fostering positive attitudes towards learning, Rowville Secondary College continues to inspire students to excel academically and personally, preparing them for a successful future.

About Amir Memon

Amir Memon currently serves as a Software Engineering Manager at YouTube, where he is instrumental in enhancing the creator experience for YouTube Shorts. His role focuses on integrating advanced capabilities and effects into the creator flow, ensuring that content creators have access to cutting-edge tools that elevate their storytelling and engagement with audiences. Amir's expertise in large language models (LLMs) and object-oriented design plays a crucial role in developing innovative features that empower creators to produce high-quality, engaging short-form videos.  
  
Under Amir's leadership, key projects have included the implementation of sophisticated algorithms that optimize video effects and filters, making them more intuitive and responsive to user input. His proficiency in distributed systems and cloud computing allows his team to build scalable web applications that can handle the vast influx of content generated by millions of users globally. Amir champions agile methodologies and Scrum practices, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages rapid iteration and continuous improvement.  
  
In addition to his technical skills, Amir is a strong advocate for mentorship and professional development within his team. He believes that cultivating a culture of learning and innovation is essential for driving success in the fast-paced tech landscape. By leveraging tools like Git and Eclipse, Amir ensures that his team adheres to best practices in software development, resulting in robust architectures that support YouTube's ambitious growth and evolving user needs. His commitment to excellence and forward-thinking approach positions him as a key player in shaping the future of content creation on one of the world's largest platforms.

About Lexington Theological Seminary
------------------------------------

Lexington Theological Seminary is the oldest seminary of the Christian Church (Disciples of Christ), leading the newest form of online education, shaping church leaders with excellent & flexible programs.  
  
Lexington Theological Seminary is an ecumenical seminary that thankfully embraces the wide diversity of denominations and theological perspectives.  
  
The Seminary offers a unique family of programs with flexibility to meet the diverse needs of people who wish to pursue a theological education. We are sensitive to the unique needs of students at various stages of life: recent college graduates, second-career seekers and persons in special situations. Students are not required to move to campus to complete their theological education.  
  
The Seminary attempts to integrate theological study with ministerial practice and personal faith formation. Every course contributes directly to the formation for ministry and the practice of ministry while providing a critical foundation for theological reflection and for relating one’s own leadership to that of the church.  
  
Coursework is explicitly linked to the congregation in which a student is participating. Students go beyond simply understanding the Scripture, theology or how to prepare a sermon; students learn to interpret the concepts being studied for the Church and to apply that knowledge in the actual setting of their congregation.

About Center for WorkLife Law | UC Hastings College of the Law

The Center for WorkLife Law (WLL) focuses, at any given time, on a few projects that hold the promise of producing meaningful social or institutional change within a three to five year timeframe. Our primary work areas include women’s advancement, interrupting racial and gender bias in the workplace, family responsibilities discrimination, pregnancy discrimination, and work-life issues for men as well as women. What services does JAFCO provide for at-risk children?

JAFCO offers a range of services aimed at supporting at-risk children, including emergency shelter for those in immediate need, foster care programs, and adoption services. Additionally, JAFCO provides family preservation resources to help families stay together and thrive, as well as developmental support for children with disabilities.

How can I get involved with JAFCO as a volunteer?

JAFCO welcomes volunteers who are passionate about making a difference in the lives of children and families. You can get involved by participating in fundraising events, helping with community outreach programs, or providing direct support to children in our care. To learn more about volunteer opportunities, please visit our website or contact our volunteer coordinator.

What types of developmental disabilities does JAFCO support?

JAFCO supports children with a variety of developmental disabilities, including but not limited to autism spectrum disorders, intellectual disabilities, and emotional disturbances. Our programs are designed to provide tailored support and resources to help these children reach their full potential in a nurturing environment.

How does JAFCO ensure the safety and well-being of children in its care?

JAFCO prioritizes the safety and well-being of all children in its programs by adhering to strict safety protocols, conducting thorough background checks on staff and volunteers, and providing ongoing training in child welfare practices. We also maintain open communication with families and community partners to ensure a supportive environment for the children.

What fundraising initiatives does JAFCO have to support its mission?

JAFCO conducts various fundraising initiatives throughout the year, including community events, galas, and online campaigns. These efforts are crucial for sustaining our programs and services. We encourage individuals and businesses to participate in or sponsor these events to help us continue our mission of supporting at-risk children and families.

Can families access resources for child welfare through JAFCO?

Yes, JAFCO provides a range of resources for families in need of child welfare support. This includes access to counseling services, parenting workshops, and educational resources. Our goal is to empower families with the tools they need to create a safe and nurturing environment for their children.

About Connecting Dreams Foundation
----------------------------------

Connecting Dreams Foundation (CDF) is a non-profit foundation registered and licensed under section 25 of the Companies Act, 1956. Government of India.  
  
The mandate of CDF is to architect social transformational interventions and campaigns using technology that create positive impact across the globe.  
  
Connecting Dreams Foundation aims to Empower youth and women in rural India through connectivity and entrepreneurship.  
  
We at CDF, believe in “bridging the difference” between the Rural and Urban India. And we aim to achieve this by setting up sustainable models of education, healthcare and livelihood in rural areas.  
  
The cities and villages when connected with each other by an appropriate technology would give rise to a healthy network and a common platform where people who need the services and the ones who provide them can come together. Connectivity, for us, is integral to discover the untapped potential of human resource.  
  
All we need to do for positive and lasting change is connect dreams, spark aspirations and share achievements.

What is MadBid.com and how does it work?

MadBid.com is an innovative online auction platform that allows users to bid on a variety of products, including electronics, fashion items, and home goods. Users purchase bidding credits to participate in auctions, where they can place bids on items they want. Each bid increases the auction price by a small increment and extends the auction timer, allowing other users to place additional bids. The last person to bid when the timer runs out wins the item at a significantly reduced price compared to retail.

What types of products can I bid on at MadBid.com?

MadBid.com offers a diverse range of products across several categories. Users can find items such as smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, fashion accessories, and home appliances. The inventory is regularly updated, so there are always new and exciting products available for bidding.

How do I purchase bidding credits on MadBid.com?

To participate in auctions on MadBid.com, users need to purchase bidding credits. This can be done through the website by selecting a credit package that suits your needs. Payment can be made using various methods, including credit/debit cards and online payment systems. Once the purchase is complete, the credits will be added to your account, allowing you to start bidding.

Is there a limit to the number of bids I can place?

There is no strict limit to the number of bids you can place on MadBid.com. However, each bid consumes one bidding credit, so the number of bids you can make is ultimately determined by the number of credits you have purchased. Users are encouraged to manage their credits wisely to maximize their chances of winning items.

What happens if I win an auction?

If you win an auction on MadBid.com, you will receive a notification confirming your win. You will then be required to complete the payment for the item at the final auction price. Once the payment is processed, the item will be shipped to the address you provided during registration. MadBid.com aims to ensure a smooth and secure transaction process for all winners.

Is MadBid.com available internationally?

MadBid.com primarily operates in select countries, and its availability may vary based on your location. While the platform is designed to cater to a global audience, shipping options and auction availability may be limited to certain regions. --------------------------------------------------

The mission of the CAC is to unite public, private and community partners to promote safety, healing and justice for child abuse victims and their families. We are Suffolk County’s frontline responders to reports of child sexual abuse, serious physical abuse, and commercial sexual exploitation of children under age 18. Founded in 1995 as a collaboration of the nonprofit Children's Advocacy Center of Suffolk County, Inc. and more than 25 child‐serving agencies, the CAC represents a true alliance between the private and public sectors resulting in streamlined, expert care for child victims and their families. We serve all Suffolk County children under age 18 who are impacted by child sexual abuse, serious physical abuse ,commercial sexual exploitation and exposure to violence.

About TUI Travel Plc.
---------------------

We’re adventure seekers. Smile givers. Impact makers.  
  
We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.  
  
We’re TUI, a leading global travel and leisure experience company that makes holiday dreams come true for people around the world.  
  
We are one of the world’s leading tourism groups counting 1200 travel agencies and online portals, five airlines with around 130 aircraft, over 400 hotels, 16 cruise liners, digital platforms for tours and activities and most importantly over 60 000 colleagues around the world. What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.  
  
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.  
  
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.  
  
There’s a place for you here.

About Yorkville Youth Athletic Association
------------------------------------------

The mission of the Yorkville Youth Athletic Association is to provide high-quality recreational activities that foster life-lessons which will empower young people to succeed beyond sports.  
  
The goal is simply to have a fun place for children to learn the game from their parents. The program has grown from 200 players to our current 6,000 athletes who enjoy recreation, instructional, after school and travel programs. The goals are the same, to have fun playing sports. Our programs operate 7 days a week, for boys and girls in grades Pre-K through 12. Our children participate in sports, performing arts, and after school programs throughout the city. We exist to serve the children and families of New York City through quality programs that promote community and friendship.  
  
Our motto is Competition, Camaraderie, and Community.

Who is the CEO of JumpstartMD?

 is the CEO of JumpstartMD. To contact [Parham Javaherian](https://contactout.com/Parham-Javaherian-3832525)

Who are the decision makers in JumpstartMD?

The decision makers in JumpstartMD are [Adrian Krutz](https://contactout.com/Adrian-KrutzMSNFNP-C-36436553)
, Chong Tseng, [Conrad Lai](https://contactout.com/Conrad-Lai-17519483)

What types of weight loss programs does JumpstartMD offer?

JumpstartMD provides personalized, medically supervised weight loss programs tailored to individual needs. These programs incorporate nutritional science, behavioral therapy, and ongoing support from healthcare professionals, including physicians, nurse practitioners, and health coaches. The approach is designed to promote sustainable weight loss through healthy lifestyle changes rather than quick fixes.

How does JumpstartMD ensure the safety and effectiveness of its programs?

JumpstartMD's programs are based on extensive clinical research and are supervised by qualified healthcare professionals. Each participant undergoes a comprehensive health assessment to create a customized plan that considers their medical history, lifestyle, and weight loss goals. Regular follow-ups and adjustments to the program ensure that participants are safe and making progress.

What role do health coaches play in the JumpstartMD program?

Health coaches at JumpstartMD are integral to the weight loss journey. They provide personalized guidance, motivation, and accountability to help participants stay on track with their goals. Coaches work closely with clients to develop strategies for overcoming challenges, maintaining healthy habits, and achieving long-term success.

Does JumpstartMD offer services for managing diabetes and metabolic health?

Yes, JumpstartMD offers specialized programs focused on diabetes prevention and management, as well as addressing cardiometabolic risk factors. These programs include nutritional counseling, lifestyle modification strategies, and ongoing support to help individuals manage their health effectively and reduce the risk of diabetes.

What is Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy (BHRT), and how does it fit into JumpstartMD's offerings?

Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy (BHRT) is a treatment that uses hormones that are chemically identical to those the human body produces. At JumpstartMD, BHRT is offered as part of a comprehensive approach to wellness, particularly for individuals experiencing hormonal imbalances that can affect weight, mood, and overall health. The therapy is supervised by qualified healthcare professionals to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Are JumpstartMD's services available for both men and women?

Absolutely! JumpstartMD provides services tailored for both men and women, addressing specific health concerns and goals. The programs are designed to meet the unique needs of each gender, including weight loss, hormonal health, and overall wellness, ensuring that all participants receive personalized care and support.

About BroadGrain Commodities Inc.
---------------------------------

BroadGrain Commodities Inc, is a leading Canadian-based global marketer and originator of grains, cereals, oilseeds, pulses, specialty crops and related by-products for both food and feed markets.  
  
BroadGrain is engaged in shipping, originating, handling, processing, storing and marketing services for the aforementioned products. We are committed to connecting producers, processors and consumers of food and agricultural commodities across the globe.  
  
At BroadGrain, quality is a top priority. We ensure traceability from farm to manufacturer and rely on our own cleaning facilities and staff to consistently supply high quality products.  
  
BroadGrain employs more than 160 people worldwide and operates in almost every continent of the world. Facilities and trading offices are located in Canada, China, United Arab Emirates (UAE), Argentina, Algeria and Nigeria. Our global footprint enables us to better cater to customers’ time zones.

What is thematic investing and how does Motif facilitate it?

Thematic investing is an investment strategy that focuses on trends or themes that are expected to drive growth in the future. Motif facilitates thematic investing by allowing investors to create or invest in 'motifs', which are portfolios of stocks or ETFs centered around a specific theme, such as renewable energy, technology innovation, or healthcare advancements. This approach enables investors to align their portfolios with their personal beliefs and interests while diversifying their investments.

What types of accounts can I open with Motif Investing?

Motif Investing offers a variety of account types to cater to different investor needs. These include individual brokerage accounts, joint accounts, retirement accounts (such as IRAs), and custodial accounts for minors. Each account type comes with its own set of features and benefits, allowing investors to choose the one that best suits their financial goals and investment strategies.

Are there any fees associated with investing through Motif?

Motif Investing operates with a transparent fee structure. While there are no commissions for trading ETFs, there is a fee for trading motifs, which typically includes a flat fee per motif trade. Additionally, investors may incur management fees for certain ETFs within their motifs. It's important to review the fee schedule on the Motif website to understand all potential costs associated with your investments.

Can I create my own motifs, and if so, how?

Yes, Motif allows investors to create their own custom motifs. To do this, you simply select a theme or idea you are passionate about and choose the stocks or ETFs you want to include in your motif. You can allocate different percentages to each asset based on your investment strategy. Once your motif is created, you can invest in it, share it with others, or even sell it on the Motif platform.

What industries does Motif support for thematic investing?

Motif supports a wide range of industries for thematic investing, including technology, healthcare, renewable energy, consumer goods, financial services, and more. Investors can explore existing motifs or create their own based on emerging trends and sectors they believe will perform well in the future. This flexibility allows for a personalized investment experience tailored to individual interests and market insights.

Is Motif Investing suitable for both individual and institutional investors?

Yes, Motif Investing is designed to cater to both individual and institutional investors. Individual investors can benefit from the ease of use and thematic investment options, while institutional investors can leverage Motif's platform for portfolio management and diversification strategies. The platform's tools and resources are tailored to meet the needs of various investor types, making it a versatile choice for anyone looking to invest.

What types of semiconductors does Adesto Technologies provide?

Adesto Technologies specializes in application-specific semiconductors tailored for the Internet of Things (IoT). Their product offerings include non-volatile memory solutions such as CBRAM, DataFlash, and Serial Flash, as well as mixed-signal and RF ASICs. They also provide communication and control chipsets designed to enhance connectivity and performance in IoT applications.

How does Adesto's technology support Power Line Communications?

Adesto Technologies offers innovative solutions for Power Line Communications (PLC), which enable data transmission over existing electrical wiring. This technology is particularly beneficial for IoT applications, allowing devices to communicate without the need for additional wiring. Adesto's PLC solutions are designed to be reliable and efficient, making them suitable for various industries, including smart home, industrial automation, and energy management.

What industries does Adesto Technologies serve?

Adesto Technologies serves a wide range of industries that leverage IoT technologies. Key sectors include consumer electronics, industrial automation, healthcare, smart energy, and automotive. Their semiconductor solutions are designed to meet the specific needs of these industries, providing enhanced performance, reliability, and energy efficiency for connected devices.

Can Adesto's solutions be integrated into existing systems?

Yes, Adesto Technologies' solutions are designed for easy integration into existing systems. Their application-specific semiconductors and systems can be seamlessly incorporated into a variety of devices and platforms, allowing customers to enhance their current offerings with advanced IoT capabilities. Adesto also provides support and resources to assist clients in the integration process.

What advantages do Adesto's non-volatile memory products offer?

Adesto's non-volatile memory products, such as CBRAM and DataFlash, offer several advantages, including low power consumption, high endurance, and fast read/write speeds. These features make them ideal for IoT applications where energy efficiency and performance are critical. Additionally, their non-volatile nature ensures that data is retained even when power is lost, which is essential for many connected devices.

How can I get support for Adesto's products?

Adesto Technologies provides comprehensive support for their products through various channels. Customers can access technical documentation, application notes, and design resources on their website. For direct assistance, customers can reach out to Adesto's support team via email or phone. Additionally, Adesto offers training and webinars to help customers better understand and utilize their technologies.

Who is the CEO of On-Demand Group?

Heather Manley is the CEO of On-Demand Group. To contact Heather Manley email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)

What types of IT consulting services does On-Demand Group offer?

On-Demand Group offers a wide range of IT consulting services, including contract staffing, direct hire, contract-to-hire solutions, and specialized consulting in areas such as Business Intelligence, Project Management, Development, eCommerce, Infrastructure, Big Data, and Quality Assurance. Our team is equipped to support various industries by providing tailored IT solutions that meet specific business needs.

How does On-Demand Group ensure the quality of its IT professionals?

On-Demand Group employs a rigorous selection process to ensure that we provide only the highest quality IT professionals. This includes thorough screening, interviews, and skills assessments. Additionally, we leverage our extensive network and industry experience to match the right candidates with the right projects, ensuring that our clients receive top-tier talent that aligns with their specific requirements.

What industries does On-Demand Group serve?

On-Demand Group serves a diverse range of industries, including but not limited to healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, and technology. Our extensive experience allows us to understand the unique challenges and requirements of each industry, enabling us to deliver customized IT solutions that drive business success.

Can On-Demand Group assist with offshore IT solutions?

Yes, On-Demand Group provides offshore IT solutions to help businesses reduce costs while maintaining high-quality service delivery. Our offshore team is skilled in various IT domains, and we ensure seamless communication and project management to meet the expectations of our clients. This allows businesses to scale their operations efficiently without compromising on quality.

What certifications does On-Demand Group hold?

On-Demand Group is proud to hold several certifications, including WBENC (Women's Business Enterprise National Council) and WSOB (Woman-Owned Small Business). These certifications reflect our commitment to diversity and inclusion in the workplace, as well as our dedication to providing exceptional services to our clients.

How can I get started with On-Demand Group's services?

Getting started with On-Demand Group is simple. You can visit our website at http://www.ondemandgroup.com to learn more about our services and solutions. Alternatively, you can contact us directly through our website or by phone to discuss your specific needs. Our team will work closely with you to understand your requirements and develop a tailored solution that fits your business goals.

Her expertise is particularly evident in her stewardship of the Practice Transition Accreditation Program (PTAP), which is designed to elevate the standards of nursing practice through rigorous accreditation processes.  
  
In her current role, Meagan spearheads compliance efforts with national accreditation standards across 51 certification programs, ensuring that they meet the regulatory requirements essential for the professional development of over 300,000 nursing professionals. Her strategic initiatives not only align with organizational goals but also reinforce a commitment to excellence in nursing education and practice. By directing quality measures and fostering a culture of continuous improvement, she enhances the integrity and value of nursing credentials.  
  
Meagan's skills in project management, curriculum development, and faculty mentoring enable her to lead impactful programs that advance nursing education. Her dedication to public speaking and teaching further amplifies her influence in the field, as she actively engages with stakeholders to promote best practices in healthcare. Through her leadership, Meagan White is not only advancing the standards of nursing accreditation but also empowering the next generation of nursing professionals to deliver exceptional patient care.

How does Hard Candy Shell approach User Experience Design?

At Hard Candy Shell, we believe that User Experience (UX) is at the heart of any successful digital product. Our approach involves thorough research and understanding of user needs, behaviors, and pain points. We utilize techniques such as user personas, journey mapping, and usability testing to inform our design decisions. Our goal is to create intuitive and enjoyable experiences that resonate with users and drive engagement.

Can Hard Candy Shell assist with mobile app development?

Yes, Hard Candy Shell specializes in iOS development, among other platforms. We work with brands to design and build mobile applications that are not only visually appealing but also optimized for performance and usability. Our team ensures that the app experience is seamless across devices, providing users with a consistent and engaging interaction.

What industries does Hard Candy Shell serve?

Hard Candy Shell has experience working with a diverse range of industries, including technology, e-commerce, healthcare, education, and entertainment. Our adaptable approach allows us to tailor our services to meet the unique needs of each industry, ensuring that we deliver effective solutions that align with our clients' goals and target audiences.

How does Hard Candy Shell ensure the quality of its digital products?

Quality assurance is a critical part of our process at Hard Candy Shell. We implement a rigorous testing phase that includes usability testing, performance testing, and cross-browser compatibility checks. Our team also gathers feedback from real users to identify areas for improvement. This iterative process helps us refine our products, ensuring they meet high standards of quality and user satisfaction.

What is the process for collaborating with Hard Candy Shell?

Collaborating with Hard Candy Shell begins with an initial consultation to understand your project goals and requirements. We then conduct research and analysis to inform our strategy. Throughout the design and development phases, we maintain open communication with our clients, providing regular updates and opportunities for feedback. Our goal is to create a partnership that fosters creativity and innovation, resulting in a final product that exceeds expectations.

Jerry Mathers is an iconic American actor best known for his role as Theodore "Beaver" Cleaver in the hit television series, "Leave It to Beaver." Born on June 2, 1948, in Sioux City, Iowa, Mathers began his acting career at a young age and became a household name during the 1950s and 1960s. His portrayal of the innocent and lovable Beaver endeared him to millions of viewers and solidified his status as a child star. Beyond his remarkable success on the small screen, Mathers has also had a diverse career in both television and film, as well as various other endeavors.  
  
At the tender age of two, Mathers' family relocated to Los Angeles, where the young actor would find his calling. His first step into the entertainment industry came at just three years old when he appeared in a Pet Condensed Milk commercial. This early experience sparked his passion for performing and led to subsequent appearances in commercials and print advertisements. Mathers' cherubic charm and natural talent quickly caught the attention of industry professionals, and in 1954, he was cast in his breakthrough role as Beaver Cleaver.  
  
"Leave It to Beaver," which aired from 1957 to 1963, followed the daily adventures and misadventures of the Cleaver family. Mathers' portrayal of the endearing, curious, and occasionally mischievous Beaver captured the hearts of audiences, making him an instant sensation. The show struck a chord with viewers of all ages, largely due to its relatable and heartwarming portrayals of family life. Mathers' innocence and boyish charm resonated deeply, transforming him into an overnight star.  
  
Beyond the tremendous success of "Leave It to Beaver," Mathers continued to expand his acting repertoire both on the small and big screens. He appeared in a wide range of television shows, including "The Ed Sullivan Show," "The Twilight Zone," and "Rawhide." In addition, Mathers starred in several highly regarded feature films, such as "The Trouble with Harry" (1955) directed by Alfred Hitchcock and "The Seven Little Foys" (1955) alongside veteran actor Bob Hope.  
  
Despite his impressive acting career, Mathers faced the challenge of transitioning from a beloved child star to an adult actor. After the end of "Leave It to Beaver," he took a brief hiatus from acting to focus on his education. Mathers returned to the entertainment industry in the late 1960s, landing various guest roles on television series and appearing in made-for-TV movies. However, he found it difficult to escape the image of Beaver Cleaver, often being typecast in similar roles. Determined to pursue his passion regardless, Mathers persevered with a positive outlook.  
  
In later years, Mathers capitalized on his enduring fame and reinvented himself as a successful businessman. He ventured into the world of real estate and established himself as a reputable professional in the industry. Moreover, Mathers actively engaged with fans, attending conventions and events related to "Leave It to Beaver," where he connected with new generations of viewers and shared behind-the-scenes stories. His warm and friendly persona, coupled with his genuine enthusiasm for the show, continued to resonate with fans worldwide, ensuring his legacy as one of television's most cherished child stars.  
  
Jerry Mathers' contribution to the entertainment industry and his embodiment of the beloved character Beaver Cleaver have left an indelible mark on American television history. His portrayal of the whimsical young boy navigating the challenges of growing up won the hearts of millions, making him a household name across generations. Despite the challenges he faced in transitioning from a child actor to an adult in Hollywood, Mathers remained optimistic and continued to pursue his passions. His enduring fame, genuine personality, and successful career beyond acting have further solidified his status as a beloved figure in American pop culture.

It supports various archdiocesan agencies that focus on spiritual enrichment, community outreach, and education, ensuring that the teachings of the Catholic Church are accessible to all.  
  
The Archdiocese operates numerous Catholic schools, providing quality education rooted in Christian values, while also offering resources for clergy and consecrated life to enhance their spiritual and professional development. Additionally, the Archdiocese is dedicated to social justice initiatives, addressing the needs of the underprivileged and promoting community welfare through various outreach programs.  
  
In terms of technology, the Archdiocese employs modern communication tools and digital platforms to engage with parishioners and the broader community, facilitating online resources for spiritual growth and education. This integration of technology not only enhances administrative efficiency but also fosters a more connected and informed community.  
  
Overall, the Archdiocese of San Antonio plays a crucial role in nurturing the spiritual and educational needs of its constituents, while actively engaging in social services that reflect the core values of compassion and service inherent in the Catholic faith. Through its diverse offerings, the Archdiocese remains a cornerstone of support and guidance for individuals and families in the San Antonio area.

Our energy efficiency consulting services involve a thorough assessment of your current energy usage and infrastructure. Caprock Renewables installs a variety of solar energy systems, including grid-tied, off-grid, and hybrid systems. Yes, Caprock Renewables provides guidance on various financing options available for renewable energy projects. We can assist clients in exploring incentives, grants, and loans that can help offset the initial investment costs. Our team is knowledgeable about federal, state, and local programs that promote renewable energy adoption and can help you navigate the financing landscape.

What are the benefits of using renewable energy solutions from Caprock Renewables?

Utilizing renewable energy solutions from Caprock Renewables offers numerous benefits, including reduced energy costs, improved energy independence, and a lower carbon footprint. Our systems are designed to enhance sustainability and resilience, providing clients with reliable energy sources while contributing to environmental conservation. Additionally, investing in renewable energy can increase property value and attract eco-conscious customers.

You’ll also be part of a company dedicated to contributing to society. Study.com has donated $23 million in-kind value across social impact programs, including matching employee contributions to non-profit organizations and millions to help schools during the pandemic. As a thought leader in the nonprofit sector, Chelsea Miller continues to drive conversations around intersectionality and leadership, making her a pivotal figure in the movement for social equity. About Lifeline Theatre
----------------------

Lifeline Theatre is driven by a passion for story. Our ensemble process supports writers in the development of literary adaptations and new work, and our theatrical and educational programs foster a lifelong engagement with literature and the arts. A cultural anchor of Rogers Park, we are committed to deepening our connection to an ever-growing family of artists and audiences, both near and far.  
  
Founded in 1983, Lifeline's home in Rogers Park – a converted Commonwealth Edison substation – includes a 99-seat theater, rehearsal and office space, costume and prop storage and a scene shop.  
  
Our 2015-16 MainStage season features three world premiere adaptations: Miss Buncle’s Book, Midnight Cowboy, and a musical version of Northanger Abbey. Our 2015-16 KidSeries season features three world premiere musical adaptations: Mr. Popper’s Penguin’s, Sparky!, and Lester’s Dreadful Sweaters  
  
All of Lifeline's productions offer dedicated performances for patrons with disabilities. We host an open-captioned performance for patrons who are deaf/hard-of-hearing, a performance with a touch tour and audio description for patrons who are blind or have low vision, and every KidSeries production features a special autism-friendly performance, offering a relaxed experience for those individuals on the autism spectrum or with cognitive/developmental disabilities.  
  
Lifeline's Student Matinee program serves over 4,000 Chicago Public School students. Our Artists-in-Residence program brings theatre education to grades K-8, working with over 900 students annually.  
  
We are seeking arts-loving individuals with experience or interest in the fields of fundraising, event planning, or strategic planning, and with diverse networks and/or ties to arts-supporting companies in the Chicago area. For more information on joining Lifeline’s Board of Directors, please contact Brian Bush, Development Manager, at 773.761.4477 x708 or [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)

About Joe's Sporting Goods
--------------------------

Joe's Sporting Goods & Ski Shop is a family owned outdoor sporting goods company in the Minneapolis and St. Paul area since 1930. Here at Joe's we offer a wide variety of outdoor gear such as fishing, hunting, camping and skiing. Our knowledgeable staff is here to assist you with any of your outdoor sporting goods needs.  
  
Joseph J. Rauscher began Joe's as a Buick repair garage in 1930. Many of his customers found a need for live bait, so Joe began to sell minnows. Soon the garage became known as Joe's Live Bait. The business really began to grow after World War II. On August 1, 1959, Joseph J. Rauscher sold the store to his son & daughter-in-law, Joseph D. and Loretta J. Rauscher. The ski business was added in October 1963. As the stores sales continued to grow, expansions were done in 1965, 1969, 1972, 1976, and the last in 1989.  
  
In August of 2003, Joe's opened our current store on 33 East County Rd B. The store on Dale St. was closed at the same time. In 2007, we launched our internet store so that we could cater to customer's nation wide.  
  
Today the store is owned by Joseph H. and James T. Rauscher, sons of Joe and Loretta.

This role further highlighted Hughes' versatility, as he effortlessly transitioned between genres and showcased his ability to excel in both dramatic and comedic roles.  
  
Hughes continued to amaze audiences with his performance in the critically acclaimed historical drama "Churchill." Not confined to the small screen, Hughes has also thrived in the world of theater. It is this genuine passion and relentless pursuit of excellence that sets him apart from his peers and continues to captivate audiences worldwide.  
  
With a growing repertoire of captivating performances, Tom Hughes has undoubtedly solidified his place as one of the most talented and compelling actors of his generation. His ability to inhabit the minds and hearts of his characters with such intensity and sincerity is a testament to his extraordinary talent. Whether he is donning period costumes or diving into intense psychological dramas, Hughes brings a magnetic energy to his performances that leaves audiences wanting more. About ScienceAbroad, the organization of Israeli scientists abroad
------------------------------------------------------------------

ScienceAbroad is an Israel-based NGO that harnesses the power of senior Israeli scientists abroad. Through its wide-reaching professional and social network, ScienceAbroad inspires connections with local communities, international scientists and with Israel. The network advances scientific achievements, bolsters the Israeli identity of scientists living overseas, and helps facilitate the return of great minds to Israel.  
Since its inception in 2006, ScienceAbroad has grown to over 3,000 members, with 25 branches worldwide, and is run by scientists who volunteer their time and expertise.  
More than 750 ScienceAbroad members have already returned to Israel.

What services does Integrated Care Solutions (ICS) provide?

Integrated Care Solutions offers a range of services focused on care coordination and management. These include patient-centered clinical solutions, innovative IT applications, data analytics, and customized advisory services. ICS specializes in areas such as bundled payments, post-acute care, care transitions, and value-based care, helping organizations improve patient outcomes and streamline operations.

How does ICS support organizations in implementing value-based care models?

ICS supports organizations in implementing value-based care models by providing tailored solutions that enhance care coordination and management. This includes data analytics to track performance metrics, advisory services to guide strategic planning, and technology solutions that facilitate communication among care teams. By focusing on patient outcomes and cost efficiency, ICS helps organizations transition smoothly to value-based care.

What industries does Integrated Care Solutions serve?

Integrated Care Solutions serves a variety of industries within the healthcare sector, including hospitals, physician practices, post-acute care facilities, and Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs). Their services are designed to meet the needs of organizations looking to improve care coordination, manage bundled payments, and enhance overall patient care across different settings.

Can ICS assist with Medicare Advantage programs?

Yes, ICS has extensive experience in supporting organizations with Medicare Advantage programs. They provide solutions that help manage care transitions, optimize care coordination, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. ICS's data analytics capabilities also enable organizations to monitor performance and improve patient outcomes within Medicare Advantage frameworks.

What is the role of data analytics in the services provided by ICS?

Data analytics plays a crucial role in the services provided by Integrated Care Solutions. It allows organizations to gain insights into patient care patterns, track performance against key metrics, and identify areas for improvement. By leveraging data analytics, ICS helps clients make informed decisions that enhance care coordination, reduce costs, and improve overall patient outcomes.

How does ICS approach care transitions for patients?

Integrated Care Solutions approaches care transitions by implementing structured processes that ensure continuity of care as patients move between different healthcare settings. This includes coordinating communication among care teams, providing patient education, and utilizing technology to track patient progress. By focusing on effective care transitions, ICS aims to reduce readmissions and improve patient satisfaction.

About Scopus
------------

Harmonic Inc. (NASDAQ: HLIT) a leading provider of broadcast and on-demand video delivery solutions, announced that it has completed the acquisition of Scopus Video Networks Ltd. (NASDAQ: SCOP) for $5.62 per share in cash, which represents an enterprise value of approximately $50 million, net of Scopus’ cash and short-term investments.  
  
The acquisition strengthens Harmonic’s technology and market leadership, particularly in the broadcast contribution and distribution markets, in addition to increasing the global customer base. Scopus’ customers will be supported by the expanded regional Harmonic sales and support teams, and through channel partners.  
  
Harmonic continues to expect cost synergies of $8-10 million on an annualized basis once Scopus becomes fully integrated into the existing Harmonic organization and management structure. The transaction is expected to be accretive to Harmonic’s non-GAAP earnings in 2009, exclusive of the amortization of intangibles and non-recurring charges such as restructuring and transaction costs.  
  
Harmonic will determine the appropriate purchase accounting for the transaction upon closing its first quarter of 2009 and, accordingly, cannot reasonably estimate the impact on GAAP earnings at this time. See “Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below.

About Jordan Valley Community Health Center
-------------------------------------------

Jordan Valley Community Health Center (JVCHC) opened in 2003, receiving the designation as a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), serving Southwest Missouri.  
  
Our mission is at JVCHC is simple, "To improve our community's health through access and relationships."  
  
We serve Southwest Missouri communities through our four clinic locations in Springfield, along with our clinics in Lebanon, Marshfield, Forsyth, Hollister and Republic, with over 600 employees. We also have six mobile units, expanding access to medical, dental and optometry care for schools and other organizations throughout the region.  
  
We offer primary medical, dental, vision and behavioral health services in a patient-centered, integrated environment. Our dental program has been the flagship, offering a variety of specialty services, including general and pediatric dentistry, along with oral surgery. Our medical program provides services for the entire family including women's health and pediatrics. The Jordan Valley Vision Clinic offers a full range of eye care services as well as the largest selection of Medicaid approved frames.

Patty Loveless is an American country music singer who has captivated audiences around the world with her powerful vocals, emotional performances, and honest storytelling. With a career spanning over three decades, Loveless has become one of the most respected and beloved country music artists of her time.  
  
Born in Pikeville, Kentucky, Loveless was raised in a musical family, surrounded by the sounds of bluegrass and traditional country. She started singing at an early age, influenced by her older brother Roger, a member of the renowned bluegrass group The Osborne Brothers. Loveless quickly developed her own unique voice, blending her Kentucky roots with a modern country sound.  
  
In the mid-1980s, Loveless signed with MCA Records and began her journey towards stardom. Her breakthrough album, "If My Heart Had Windows," was released in 1988 and showcased her incredible talent and heartfelt performances. It included the hit singles "Timber I'm Falling in Love" and "Blue Side of Town," which solidified her status as a rising star in the country music industry.  
  
Loveless' success continued throughout the 1990s with a string of chart-topping hits that showcased her versatility as an artist. Her album "The Trouble with the Truth" spawned several memorable tracks, including the emotional ballad "You Don't Even Know Who I Am," which earned her a Grammy award for Best Country Vocal Performance, Female.  
  
Known for her powerful voice and ability to connect deeply with her audience, Loveless has delivered some of the most heart-wrenching performances in country music history. She has the rare gift of making her listeners feel every word and emotion in her songs, be it heartbreak, resilience, or profound joy.  
  
One of Loveless' most iconic albums, "Mountain Soul," released in 2001, showcased a return to her Appalachian roots and received critical acclaim. This intimate collection of songs celebrated her Kentucky heritage and explored themes of love, loss, and the ruggedness of mountain life. It solidified Loveless' position as a country music luminary and received Grammy nominations for Best Bluegrass Album and Best Female Country Vocal Performance.  
  
Throughout her career, Loveless has released a diverse range of albums, exploring various sounds and genres within country music. Whether it's traditional honky-tonk, bluegrass, or contemporary country, Loveless delivers her signature, soul-stirring performances with authenticity and passion, always staying true to her roots.  
  
Beyond her numerous awards and accolades, Loveless has left an indelible mark on the country music landscape, inspiring countless artists with her talent and authenticity. Her music resonates with listeners from all walks of life, as she tackles universal themes of love, heartache, and the human experience.  
  
Patty Loveless is not just a country music artist; she is a vocalist who wears her heart on her sleeve, and her songs have become anthems for those who have experienced the highs and lows of life. Her ability to transform each lyric into an emotional journey is what sets her apart as a true artist.  
  
In an industry that often prioritizes style over substance, Loveless remains a beacon of authenticity, representing the best of country music's roots and traditions. With her distinct voice, unwavering passion, and genuine connection to her audience, Patty Loveless has secured her place as one of the greatest voices in American music.

Throughout his career, Neely has remained dedicated to celebrating the rich culinary heritage of the American South and sharing his love of soul food with the world. Whether he's grilling up tender ribs at his restaurants or sharing his culinary expertise on television, Neely's goal is always the same: to bring people together through the power of good food and genuine hospitality.  
  
In addition to his work in the culinary world, Neely is also a devoted philanthropist who uses his platform to give back to his community and support causes close to his heart. He is actively involved in various charitable organizations and regularly participates in fundraising events to help those in need. Neely's commitment to making a positive impact extends far beyond the kitchen, and his generosity has endeared him to fans and colleagues alike.  
  
With his warm smile, Southern charm, and unwavering passion for soul food, Pat Neely has earned his place as a beloved figure in the culinary world. About Pennington Biomedical Research Center
-------------------------------------------

Pennington Biomedical Research Center, a campus of Louisiana State University, is a world-renowned leader at the forefront of medical discoveries as it relates to obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, cancer, and dementia.  
  
Our mission is to improve human health throughout the lifespan.  
  
Today, our center houses almost 500 employees, 14 research laboratories, 17 core service laboratories, and a team of over 80 scientists and physicians.  
  
There are three NIH Centers of Excellence at Pennington Biomedical Research Center, the Center for Research on Botanicals and Metabolic Syndrome (BRC), the Center of Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), and the Nutrition and Obesity Research Center (NORC).  
  
Our scientists conduct basic, clinical, and population health research and are dedicated to solving the world-wide obesity epidemic by 2040.

About Vigour a.s.
-----------------

Unicorn je renomovaná evropská společnost poskytující ty největší informační systémy a řešení z oblasti informačních technologií. Dlouhodobě se soustředíme na vysokou přidanou hodnotu a konkurenční výhodu přinášenou našim zákazníkům. Působíme na trhu již od roku 1990 a za tu dobu jsme vytvořili řadu špičkových a rozsáhlých řešení, která jsou rozšířena a užívána mezi těmi nejvýznamnějšími podniky z různých odvětví. Máme ty nejlepší reference z oblasti bankovnictví, pojišťovnictví, energetiky a utilit, komunikace a médií, výroby, obchodu i veřejné správy. Našimi zákazníky jsou přední a největší firmy. Jsme však zároveň provozovateli internetové služby Plus4U, ve které nabízíme široké portfolio služeb založených na robustních softwarových řešeních pro malé a střední podniky a hlavně pro lidi. V internetové službě Plus4U si každý z nás vytvoří svůj digitální prostor a propojí se s digitálními prostory těch ostatních - jednotlivců i podniků a organizací. Disponujeme detailními znalostmi z celého spektra podnikatelských odvětví. Rozumíme principům jejich fungování, ale i specifickým potřebám svých zákazníků.  
  
Naším cílem je vzdělávat lidi a také společnost. Proto jsme v roce 2007 založili Unicorn University, která zároveň provozuje Unicorn Top Gun Academy - komplexní vzdělávací systém pro naše spolupracovníky, tedy pro všechny z nás. Unicorn University není jen tradiční vysoká škola. Jsme plně online. Naší ambicí je podporovat online vzdělávání od základních škol až po univerzity včetně systémů celoživotního vzdělání. Prostě, software je všude.

About Apixio
------------

Apixio is advancing value-based care delivery with data-driven intelligence and analytics. Our AI-powered Apicare platform gives organizations across the healthcare spectrum the power to mine clinical information at scale, creating meaningful insights that will change the way healthcare is measured, care is delivered, and value is realized.  
  
The promise of value-based care is where healthcare is going, but achieving the goals requires more effort, especially around healthcare data. With issues of data siloed and unstructured data underused, health plans and providers need help to reduce the administrative burden and deliver more meaningful patient care. Apixio is leveraging AI-driven analytics across the healthcare ecosystem and at the point-of-care, where it matters most.  
  
Apixio’s Apicare platform gives organizations actionable insights across their value-based care programs. We have analyzed over 40 million charts and over 1 billion pages of clinical documents to generate a patient phenotype, a longitudinal view of a patient health record that surfaces actionable insights. This translates into better care delivery, improving payer-provider collaboration, and reducing administrative waste. As a result, Apixio is creating a smarter approach to healthcare.

Who is the CEO of Apixio?

.

Who are the decision makers in Apixio?

, Alan Sun, [Brad Ross](https://contactout.com/brad-ross-21716)

.

What is Apixio and what services do they offer?

Apixio is a healthcare technology company that leverages artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to enhance value-based care delivery. Their primary offering is the Apicare platform, which enables healthcare organizations to mine clinical data at scale. Apixio provides a range of services including interoperability solutions, risk adjustment technology, and tailored solutions for both healthcare providers and payers, helping them improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency.

How does Apixio's Apicare platform improve healthcare delivery?

The Apicare platform utilizes AI-driven analytics to extract and analyze clinical information from various data sources. By providing actionable insights, the platform helps healthcare organizations identify care gaps, optimize resource allocation, and enhance patient engagement. This ultimately leads to improved health outcomes and reduced costs, aligning with the goals of value-based care.

What industries does Apixio support?

Apixio primarily supports the healthcare industry, including both healthcare providers and payers. Their solutions are designed to address the unique challenges faced by these stakeholders, such as improving care coordination, enhancing risk adjustment processes, and ensuring interoperability between different healthcare systems. By focusing on these areas, Apixio aims to facilitate better healthcare delivery and outcomes across the spectrum.

What are interoperability solutions and why are they important?

Interoperability solutions refer to technologies and processes that enable different healthcare systems and applications to communicate and share data effectively. Apixio's interoperability solutions are crucial for ensuring that healthcare providers and payers can access comprehensive patient information, which is essential for coordinated care, accurate risk assessments, and improved decision-making. By facilitating data exchange, these solutions help overcome silos in healthcare data, leading to better patient outcomes.

How does Apixio's risk adjustment technology benefit healthcare organizations?

Apixio's risk adjustment technology helps healthcare organizations accurately assess and manage patient risk profiles. By utilizing advanced analytics to analyze clinical data, the technology enables organizations to identify high-risk patients, optimize care plans, and ensure appropriate reimbursement. This not only enhances financial performance but also supports better patient care by allowing providers to allocate resources more effectively.

Can Apixio's solutions be integrated with existing healthcare systems?

Yes, Apixio's solutions are designed with interoperability in mind, allowing them to be integrated with a variety of existing healthcare systems and electronic health records (EHRs). This seamless integration ensures that healthcare organizations can leverage their current data infrastructure while enhancing their capabilities with Apixio's advanced analytics and AI-driven insights. This flexibility makes it easier for organizations to adopt Apixio's solutions without significant disruptions to their operations.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Alan

Who is the CEO of Alan?

Alessandro Barone is the CEO of Alan. To contact Alessandro Barone email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
.

What services does Alan offer to promote health and well-being?

Alan provides a comprehensive range of services designed to enhance both physical and mental health. These include personalized health insurance plans, access to a network of healthcare professionals, wellness programs, mental health support, and tools for managing health and wellness. Our goal is to ensure that every individual has the resources they need to lead a healthy and productive life.

How does Alan's health insurance work?

Alan's health insurance is designed to be user-friendly and transparent. Members can choose from various plans that cover a wide range of medical services, including consultations, treatments, and preventive care. Our platform allows users to easily manage their health insurance, submit claims, and access their benefits online. We aim to simplify the insurance experience and ensure that our members receive the care they need without unnecessary hassle.

What industries does Alan support with its health solutions?

Alan supports a diverse range of industries, including tech, finance, healthcare, and education. We understand that each industry has unique health and wellness needs, and we tailor our solutions accordingly. By partnering with businesses across various sectors, we help them create healthier work environments and improve employee well-being, ultimately leading to increased productivity and job satisfaction.

Can I access mental health support through Alan?

Yes, Alan offers comprehensive mental health support as part of our commitment to overall well-being. Members can access a variety of resources, including counseling services, therapy sessions, and mental health workshops. Our platform connects individuals with licensed professionals who can provide the necessary support and guidance to help them navigate their mental health challenges.

How does Alan empower individuals to take charge of their health?

Alan empowers individuals by providing them with intuitive tools and resources that promote proactive health management. Our platform includes features such as personalized health assessments, wellness tracking, and educational content on healthy living. By encouraging users to engage with their health data and make informed decisions, we help them take control of their health journey and achieve their wellness goals.

Is Alan available for individuals or only for businesses?

Alan offers services for both individuals and businesses. Individuals can sign up for personal health insurance plans and access wellness resources directly through our platform. For businesses, we provide tailored health solutions that can be integrated into employee benefits packages. This dual approach allows us to cater to a wide audience and promote health and well-being across different demographics.

The mission of the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC), a subsidiary of the American Nurses Association (ANA), is to promote excellence in nursing and health care globally through credentialing programs. ANCC’s internationally renowned credentialing programs certify and recognize individual nurses in specialty practice areas. ANCC recognizes healthcare organizations that promote nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes while providing safe, positive work environments. About Old Chicago Restaurants
-----------------------------

Four decades strong, Old Chicago Pizza + Taproom has built its foundation on being the Craft Beer Authority, great tasting food & beverages, passionate & knowledgeable employees, community and craft beer exploration. We credit our tenure and successful growth to the quality and character embodied in every single teammate.  
  
We're a family of 7,500 strong; we believe it's our commitment to our people to provide a workplace culture that values people first, transparency, accountability, high performance and integrity. Trends come and go but quality endures. And that quality - in our hospitality, in our food, and in our beer - is what Old Chicago is all about.  
  
Old Chicago has worked to develop a ‘kitchen of the future’ that focuses on all the functions of a food service kitchen. The basic principles of design include modularity, flexibility, simplicity, efficiency, ease of sanitation, ease of employee supervision, and efficiency of space. The overall space design was based upon product flow and human engineering, with special consideration to how each employee interacts within their individual work stations.  
  
When you join the team at Old Chicago, you are joining the SPB Hospitalty Family. Managers and Team Members are trained on core principals and systems throughout SPB Hospitalty brands. With this foundation, it is easy to transfer and advance throughout our company no matter the brand or location. With over 200 restaurants and 11 unique brands, we have unlimited opportunities for our team members.  
  
It's an especially exciting time to join Old Chicago as we are currently investing in and refreshing all of our existing locations. Check out our website to see the career opportunities we've got on tap for you!

Based in Augusta, Georgia, Augusta University Health is a world-class health care network, offering the most comprehensive primary, specialty and subspecialty care in the region. Augusta University Health is a not-for-profit corporation that manages the clinical operations associated with Augusta University.  
The academic medical center difference  
Being an academic health center, Augusta University Health differs from community hospitals. We have three primary missions— patient care, education and research. As an academic health center, we must provide a full range of clinical services and maintain the infrastructure to foster education and research.  
Our physicians have the most up-to-date knowledge and training. Many of our health care professionals train the next generation of caregivers, while others conduct pioneering research that improves medical diagnosis, treatments and technology, bringing the medicine of tomorrow to patient care today.  
  
In short, Augusta University Health brings world-class clinicians, pioneering research, and the latest technologies and breakthroughs right here in Augusta.

About ofo
---------

Founded in 2014, ofo is the world’s leading “station-free” bike-sharing platform operated via an online mobile application. Our mission is to solve the "last mile" problem of urban transportation, helping commuters and travelers get to exactly where they need to go by making bikes accessible to everyone. As of today, we have successfully connected more than 8 million bikes in more than 170 cities in over seven countries. Our global community of users generates more than 25 million daily transactions.The ofo platform is easy to use. After downloading the ofo mobile phone app (iOS/Android), users may scan the QR code or enter the plate number displayed on each bike to receive a passcode and unlock it. Our bike-sharing system requires no docking stations, providing significant flexibility for users to find and return bikes anywhere, anytime. Once they reach their destination, the user may park the bike anywhere that is legitimate, convenient, and easy for the next user to access. But ofo does more than help commuters and travelers access bikes for getting around their cities. As a partner of the UN Development Programme, we are focused on achieving Global Sustainability Goals and promoting green and healthy living, and we have also launched a partnership with Rihanna's Clara Lionel Foundation to provide bikes and scholarships for schoolgirls in Malawi.

About Emma Mcentyre Merrick

Emma McEntyre Merrick is a distinguished ballerina and ballet instructor at the prestigious New York City Ballet, where her journey began at the tender age of 14. With a rigorous training regimen that spanned four years, Emma honed her craft under the guidance of some of the most esteemed instructors in the ballet world. By the time she turned 18, she had earned the coveted title of Prima Ballerina, a testament to her exceptional talent and dedication. Throughout her career, Emma has performed in iconic ballets across the globe, captivating audiences with her grace and artistry.  
  
In her current role, Emma not only showcases her extraordinary skills on stage but also imparts her extensive knowledge to the next generation of dancers as a ballet instructor. Her teaching philosophy emphasizes the importance of discipline, creativity, and emotional expression, fostering an environment where young dancers can thrive. Emma's expertise extends beyond performance; she is adept in team management and project management, skills that she employs to coordinate various ballet programs and workshops.  
  
Emma's background in higher education and youth mentoring further enriches her teaching approach, allowing her to connect with students on multiple levels. Her commitment to nurturing talent is evident in her involvement in community outreach programs, where she encourages underprivileged youth to explore the world of ballet. With a unique blend of artistry, leadership, and mentorship, Emma McEntyre Merrick continues to make a significant impact in the ballet community, inspiring future generations to pursue their passion for dance.

About AgIS Capital LLC
----------------------

AgIS Capital LLC, headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, is a distinguished employee-owned management firm specializing in investments in farmland and related operating companies. With a keen focus on the agricultural sector, AgIS partners with sophisticated institutional investors seeking to enhance their portfolios through diversification, inflation hedging, and the exploitation of sector inefficiencies that can yield premium returns. The firm’s tailored investment strategies are designed to align with the specific objectives of its clients, ensuring a personalized approach that maximizes value.  
  
The principals at AgIS Capital bring decades of extensive experience, having successfully completed agricultural transactions worth several billion dollars. This impressive track record underscores their deep understanding of the complexities and opportunities within the global agricultural landscape. AgIS Capital serves a diverse range of clients, including pension funds, endowments, and family offices, all of whom benefit from the firm’s nimble investment philosophy and strategic insights.  
  
In addition to traditional farmland investments, AgIS Capital is adept at identifying and capitalizing on innovative agricultural technologies and sustainable practices that enhance productivity and profitability. By leveraging advanced analytics and market intelligence, AgIS is well-positioned to navigate the evolving agricultural landscape, providing clients with unique opportunities to capture value in a sector that is increasingly recognized for its potential in a diversified investment strategy. With a commitment to delivering exceptional results, AgIS Capital stands out as a trusted partner for institutional investors looking to make impactful investments in agriculture.

What services does AgIS Capital LLC offer?

AgIS Capital LLC specializes in providing financial and strategic advisory services tailored for the agriculture and food sectors. Our services include investment management, risk assessment, market analysis, and operational consulting. We aim to help clients navigate the complexities of the agricultural landscape, optimize their investments, and enhance operational efficiency.

Which industries does AgIS Capital support?

AgIS Capital primarily focuses on the agriculture and food industries. This includes sectors such as crop production, livestock management, food processing, and agricultural technology. We also engage with related industries such as agribusiness, supply chain management, and sustainability initiatives to provide comprehensive support to our clients.

How does AgIS Capital assist with investment management?

AgIS Capital offers a range of investment management services designed to maximize returns while minimizing risks for our clients. We conduct thorough market research, identify investment opportunities in the agricultural sector, and provide ongoing portfolio management. Our team utilizes data-driven insights to guide investment decisions and ensure alignment with our clients' financial goals.

Can AgIS Capital help with sustainability initiatives in agriculture?

Yes, AgIS Capital is committed to promoting sustainability within the agricultural sector. We offer consulting services that help clients implement sustainable practices, improve resource efficiency, and reduce environmental impact. Our team works with clients to develop strategies that align with their sustainability goals while also enhancing profitability.

What is the process for engaging with AgIS Capital for consulting services?

Engaging with AgIS Capital begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and objectives. Our team will then conduct a thorough assessment of your current operations and market position. Based on this analysis, we will develop a tailored strategy and action plan. We maintain open communication throughout the process to ensure that our solutions align with your goals.

Does AgIS Capital provide support for startups in the agriculture sector?

Absolutely! AgIS Capital is dedicated to supporting startups and emerging businesses in the agriculture sector. We offer advisory services that include business planning, market entry strategies, and access to funding opportunities. Our team leverages its extensive network and industry expertise to help startups navigate challenges and achieve sustainable growth.

About Paula Marshall

Paula Marshall, a dedicated educator and mentor, has transitioned into retirement after an impactful 29-year career in high school science education. During her tenure, she not only taught but also inspired countless students to explore the wonders of the physical sciences, fostering a love for learning that extends beyond the classroom. Her expertise in student affairs and development allowed her to create a nurturing environment where students felt encouraged to challenge themselves and pursue their academic goals.  
  
Now, as she embraces retirement, Paula channels her passion for education into various enriching activities. Her current endeavors include genealogy research, where she delves into her family history, uncovering stories that connect past generations to the present. This pursuit not only satisfies her curiosity but also enhances her skills in research and community outreach, as she often shares her findings with local historical societies.  
  
In addition to genealogy, Paula is actively involved in sewing and restoring her beautiful 100-year-old Georgian home, a project that reflects her appreciation for history and craftsmanship. Through these creative ventures, she continues to apply her skills in public speaking and staff development by volunteering in her community, sharing her knowledge and experiences with others. Paula’s life after retirement is a testament to her belief in lifelong learning and mentorship, as she remains committed to encouraging others to reach their potential, whether in the classroom or beyond. Life, indeed, is grand for Paula Marshall, as she finds joy in every new chapter.

About Cushnie
-------------

CUSHNIE is a luxury women’s ready-to-wear and accessories brand designed by Carly Cushnie.  
  
At the helm of her namesake label as CEO, Creative Director and Co-Founder, Carly Cushnie sets forth with a mission to empower women, and to celebrate diversity and inclusion in all aspects of the business.  
  
Established in 2008, the label was founded on the desire to serve the modern woman. Artfully crafted with clean, sculptural lines, the CUSHNIE collection is precisely tailored to achieve the perfect fit for the female form. Defined by the balance of proportion, structure and fluidity, the CUSHNIE aesthetic embodies a refined sense of cosmopolitan minimalism and femininity.  
  
“As a woman, I understand what my customer wants from her clothes. I’ve grown and evolved alongside her over the past 10 years, and I strive to present her with timeless silhouettes that make her feel sexy, sophisticated and powerful — all at once.”  
  
The CUSHNIE Collection is worn by influential women including Michelle Obama, Beyoncé, Gal Gadot, Lupita Nyong’o, Ava Duvernay, Jessica Biel, Jennifer Lopez, Ashley Graham, and Padma Lakshmi, among many others.  
  
CUSHNIE is distributed through over 100 premiere stockists worldwide. The brand was a winner of the Ecco Domani Award (2009), a finalist for the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund (2011) and a nominee for the CFDA Swarovski Award (2012).

Irene’s passion for event management and problem-solving shines through in her ability to coordinate complex initiatives that drive organizational change.
