About Reboot.
-------------

Reboot is an arts and culture non-profit that reimagines and reinforces Jewish thought and traditions. As a premier R&D platform for the Jewish world, we catalyze our Reboot Network of preeminent creators, artists, entrepreneurs and activists to produce experiences and products that evolve the Jewish conversation and transform society.  
  
All Reboot projects imagine Jewish ritual and tradition afresh, offering an inviting mix of discovery, experience and reflection through events, exhibitions, recordings, books, films, DIY activity toolkits and apps. These projects have engaged more than 5.5 million participants in the past five years and continue to inspire Jewish connections and meaning by encouraging participants to become creators in their Jewish experience. Our year-round activities are supported by an annual tentpole event—the Reboot Summit, a closed gathering that convenes a diverse group of prominent Jewish change agents in an intellectually-provocative environment that inspires them to discover new ways to engage with their Judaism.  
  
The world is an ever-complicated place and will be even more complicated in the coming years. For 19 years, Reboot has been gathering and catalyzing some of the best and brightest change-agents for off-the-record conversations about Jewish identity and meaning, and has seen first-hand the power of imagination and uncensored dialogue to translate and transform the big issues of our time. As the stakes rise, we are amplifying these vital ideas and bringing in wider perspectives to identify and carve new pathways for wandering Jews and the world we live in. In response to COVID-19, we are creating a series of public digital programs that showcase and amplify these conversations and ideas. We plan to expand this to public in-person gatherings when public health and safety allows.

In een markt met veel concurrentie staan de marges van groothandels en productiebedrijven onder druk. Wij helpen onze klanten online zichtbaar te zijn met innovatieve en schaalbare webshop-oplossingen. Met E-OPS bieden we u een branchespecifieke webshop met relevante modules, zodat u kunt voldoen aan de hoge eisen van uw klant.

Al onze klanten hebben immers behoefte aan een goed werkende IT-infrastructuur en professionele en betaalbare software-oplossingen.

Wij zijn trots op onze mensen: stuk voor stuk specialisten in hun vakgebied of het nu gaat over development, IT-support of engineering. About GuiaBolso
---------------

Fundado em 2012 por Benjamin Gleason e Thiago Alvarez, o GuiaBolso nasceu com o propósito de liderar a transformação do sistema financeiro para melhorar a vida dos brasileiros e somos apaixonados por essa missão. A startup detém o primeiro app de controle financeiro automático do Brasil e é o mais baixado atualmente, com mais de 4 milhões de usuários.  
  
Em um ambiente colaborativo, prezamos pela excelência nas entregas, porque queremos sair na frente em tudo que fazemos. Somos estimulados a tomar decisões com coragem e senso de dono, para que possamos aprender rápido com nossos acertos e erros. Valorizamos a diversidade e o bem-estar de todos, pois as pessoas são nosso foco. A segurança que passamos para os nossos usuários começa aqui dentro, ao agirmos sempre com transparência, construindo relações de confiança.  
  
A Fintech já recebeu investimentos de fundos renomados como Vostok, Kaszek Ventures, Ribbit Capital, QED Investors, Omidyar Network e do IFC, braço financeiro do Banco Mundial.  
  
O app já se destacou em diversos eventos e premiações internacionais das áreas de tecnologia e inovação. Em 2014, fomos eleitos a melhor startup pela InfoExame e votado melhor app brasileiro pelos leitores do G1. Em 2015, recebemos o prêmio de melhor empresa B2C concedido pela LATAM Founders, rede de executivos e investidores de tecnologia. Em 2016 e 2017, entramos para o ranking da KPMG como uma das fintechs brasileiras mais inovadoras do mundo.  
  
A empresa conta com os conselheiros Neil Daswani, especialista internacional em segurança na internet e professor da Universidade Stanford nos EUA, e Guilherme Horn, fundador das empresas de investimentos online Ágora e Órama. Além disso, tem parcerias com Endeavor e Harvard Business School.  
  
Fique de olho nas oportunidades e #VemSerGuia: https://jobs.kenoby.com/guiabolso

A3Ventures is the innovation lab and capital investment arm of AAA Northern California, Nevada & Utah (NCNU). Our mission is to develop groundbreaking solutions that serve communities in face of disruption.  
  
Our diverse team of designers, product managers, engineers, analysts, researchers and strategists work to prototype solutions and bring them to market. Our venture capital arm invests directly in innovative startups whose products that can benefit the communities we serve.  
  
In April 2017 we launched our first product, GIG Car Share — the Bay Area's first hybrid-electric, one-way car share.  
  
We are a proud investor in RapidSOS, a breakthrough technology that solves the 911 mobile location problem.  
  
Our thesis & opportunity:  
  
Technology is only as advanced as its ability to advance people. Today, disruptive forces and megatrends are rapidly changing our world. The Internet of things, collaborative consumption, and increasingly autonomous vehicles will continue to foster disruptive business models and new entrants that will significantly change consumer behavior and traditional value propositions. However, these forces also provide society with a tremendous opportunity for radical innovation and growth.

About Simons Foundation
-----------------------

The Simons Foundation’s mission is to advance the frontiers of research in mathematics and the basic sciences.  
  
Co-founded in New York City by Jim and Marilyn Simons, the foundation exists to support basic — or discovery-driven — scientific research undertaken in the pursuit of understanding the phenomena of our world.  
  
The Simons Foundation’s support of science takes two forms: We support research by making grants to individual investigators and their projects through academic institutions, and, with the launch of the Flatiron Institute in 2016, we now conduct scientific research in-house, supporting teams of top computational scientists.  
  
To learn more about our initiatives please visit our about page here: https://www.simonsfoundation.org/about  
  
You may access our 2021 online annual report here: https://annualreports.simonsfoundation.org/2021/

About UERJ
----------

Criada em 1950, a Universidade do Estado do Rio de Janeiro é considerada a 8ª instituição de ensino superior mais importante do país, segundo o World University Rankings 2021-22. A Uerj reúne cerca de 40 mil alunos, nos cursos de graduação, pós-graduação e ensino básico, distribuídos em 15 campi. Também conta com duas unidades de saúde: o Hospital Universitário Pedro Ernesto e a Policlínica Piquet Carneiro. O quadro de pessoal possui aproximadamente três mil professores, a maior parte qualificada com doutorado, e mais de cinco mil técnicos administrativos. A Uerj destaca-se ainda pelo caráter inclusivo, sendo pioneira na implantação da política de cotas.

About Tom Bates

Tom Bates is a dynamic and hands-on leader with a proven track record in transforming traditional media landscapes into thriving digital enterprises. As an Advisor at Advance Local, he leverages his extensive experience in digital strategy to guide one of the largest local media groups in the United States. His current role involves advising on innovative approaches to advertising sales, digital marketing, and overall strategic direction, ensuring that the organization remains at the forefront of the rapidly evolving media industry.  
  
One of Tom's most significant achievements has been the successful transformation of the Pulitzer Prize-winning Alabama Media Group. Under his leadership, the organization transitioned from a legacy media business into a profitable all-digital operation, boasting the largest investigative news team in the Southeast. This transformation not only enhanced the group's financial performance but also solidified its reputation for journalistic excellence, as evidenced by the four Pulitzer Prizes awarded during his tenure.  
  
Tom's expertise in leading change and entrepreneurship has been instrumental in navigating the complexities of the digital landscape. He has a keen understanding of P&L management, allowing him to drive sustainable growth while maintaining a commitment to quality journalism. His strategic insights into internet advertising and digital marketing have positioned Advance Local to capitalize on emerging trends and audience engagement strategies, ensuring that the organization remains competitive in a crowded marketplace. With a focus on innovation and a passion for storytelling, Tom Bates continues to shape the future of local media, empowering teams to deliver impactful content that resonates with communities.

About Educators for Excellence
------------------------------

About us  
  
Educators for Excellence is a teacher-led organization that ensures teachers have a leading voice in the policies that impact their students and profession.  
  
Our nation’s education system is leaving millions of students—including an overwhelming number of students of color and low-income students—unprepared for college, career, and life. Only one in 10 students of color and low-income students graduate from college in the United States. The result is an opportunity gap and divide along racial and class lines that threatens the future of our communities, economy, and democracy.  
  
While research shows that classroom teachers are the single most important in-school factor in improving student achievement, their diverse voices are consistently left out of education policy decisions. Even though policymakers at every level of the system are talking about teachers, they rarely are talking with teachers.  
  
Founded by public school teachers, Educators for Excellence is a growing movement of 25,000 educators, united around a common set of values and principles for improving student learning and elevating the teaching profession. We work together to identify issues that impact our schools, create solutions to these challenges, and advocate for policies and programs that give all students access to a quality education.

About Emissary
--------------

Medical tourism you can trust.  
  
What we do:  
People come to www.emissarymed.com every day because they can't afford their out of pocket cost for medical or dental treatment they need. We’re building the first global medical tourism marketplace that focuses on trust & quality. For every prospective hospital we work with, we ask ourselves: would we send our own parents here? Our clients can see their options all over the world, with transparent pricing, ratings, testimonials, HD photographs, and a dedicated account executive from our U.S. team to answer questions and guide them through the process.  
  
Once clients give us a downpayment, their Emissary account exec is available any time via phone or email. On their trip, our mobile app keeps them connected to us, our partners, and their loved ones 24/7, and our English-fluent partners at the destination hospital make sure everything goes smoothly while they’re there.  
  
  
Why we do it:  
In 2013, my friend's mom needed serious arthritis surgery. Even though her family had insurance, she still couldn't afford it in the US. Her family in India helped her find a doctor she could trust near them, and despite the travel and hotel (her whole family went with her!) she still saved $20,000. There were no options online she could trust to help her do her research, so if it weren't for a family connection, who knows what she would've done.  
  
Medical and dental care are broken in the U.S. We're aiming to offer an alternative using web & mobile tech, plus data transparency, to help people alternatives they can trust, during such a difficult time of their lives.

About SaaStr
------------

SaaStr is the world’s largest community of SaaS executives, founders, and entrepreneurs.  
  
Our goal is to help everyone get from $0 to $100m ARR with less stress and more success. We do that with a combination of industry-leading content and community connections. The SaaStr Annual is the largest non-vendor event in the industry.  
  
SaaStr began in 2012 as a simple WordPress blog and a few answers on Quora sharing EchoSign founder Jason Lemkin’s learnings of going from $0 to $100m ARR at EchoSign. This led to our first meet-ups in 2013, the first SaaStr Annual in 2015, the industry’s leading podcast in 2016, the first coworking space in 2017, and the first learning management system for SaaS CEOs in 2018.  
  
To continue expanding and serving the community, SaaStr has grown its offerings to include regional and global events, a co-selling space, an investment fund, and an automated e-learning platform.  
  
SaaStr has been named one of the Top 100 Blogs for Entrepreneurs but Forbes and one of the 50 Best Websites for Entrepreneurs by Inc. Magazine, and a Top Writer on Quora six times. Jason has been named by Business Insider to the 32 Most Powerful People in Business Technology.

These resources are designed to help individuals navigate the challenges of building and scaling a SaaS business.

How can SaaStr help my SaaS company grow from $0 to $100M ARR?

SaaStr provides actionable insights, best practices, and strategies tailored for SaaS growth. Through their extensive library of content, community discussions, and expert advice, SaaStr helps entrepreneurs understand key metrics, optimize their sales processes, and implement effective marketing strategies to accelerate growth and achieve significant annual recurring revenue (ARR).

Does SaaStr cater to both SMBs and enterprise-level SaaS companies?

Yes, SaaStr supports both SMBs and enterprise-level SaaS companies. The community is diverse, encompassing a wide range of business sizes and models. SaaStr offers tailored advice and resources that address the unique challenges faced by both segments, ensuring that all members can find relevant support and guidance.

However, some events or premium content may have associated fees. The community aims to provide valuable support to all SaaS professionals, regardless of their budget.

What industries does SaaStr focus on, and can it help with freemium models?

SaaStr primarily focuses on the Software as a Service (SaaS) industry, which spans various sectors including technology, finance, healthcare, and more. About ALSET LED Lighting
------------------------

NuWave, LLC, the proud maker of Alset® LED Lighting, is a leading OEM manufacturer that supplies innovative components to some of the largest corporations worldwide. Founded in 1993 in the Greater Chicago Area, we have grown into a multinational corporation with offices and distribution throughout the world.  
  
Distribution is fulfilled from our 400,000 sq. foot warehouse that is located on-site with our Chicago headquarters. Alset® LED is backed by our world-class research and development team that is focused on developing innovative solutions in the LED lighting industry. With our passion and devotion to advancements in LED lighting, our team has earned the respect of lighting distributors, architects, designers, engineers, and related professionals worldwide.  
  
From its inception, our business model has been unique – we fully integrate our team into each step of the manufacturing and distribution processes to make sure that our products are closely monitored and maintained from early-on research & development all the way to the fulfillment of the deliverables to the end-user. Alset® LED Lighting does much more than “sell” lights; we are a company that provides lighting solutions to make a brighter future by making the right decisions in the present.  
  
That’s our Alset® LED goal, and that’s our promise to the world.  
  
Our expertise in components manufacturing is directly evident in the quality of our lighting products. With extensive product development labs, testing facilities, and in-house market research, we are confident that our price, quality, and warranty are at the top of the market. Accordingly, Alset® LED products exceed the highest standards available in the lighting industry. Alset® LED products are LM-79, LM-80, and TM-21 tested, UL or ETL listed, and backed by warranties that exceed industry standards.  
  
In addition, many Alset® LED products are Energy Star and DesignLights Consortium (DLC) qualifying our products for local rebate programs.

About David Glasco

David Glasco serves as the Vice President of the Compute Solutions Group (CSG) at Cadence Design Systems, where he plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of hardware and software design within the Silicon Solutions Group (SSG). With over 25 years of extensive experience in the semiconductor and software industries, David leads a talented team of over 600 engineers, driving innovation in Cadence’s comprehensive soft IP portfolio. His leadership is instrumental in the development of cutting-edge technologies, including the Neo NPU and NeuroWeave AI Compiler, as well as the widely recognized Tensilica DSPs and DSP Libraries.

Since 20 years the founders of Globalance are pioneers: They successfully built up the world’s leading asset manager for sustainable investments, SAM that managed 13 bn. USD in assets after 13 years. In November 2020 Globalance launched Globalance World - a digital, interactive globe for sustainable investments. What is Vega Protocol and how does it transform the financial system?

Vega Protocol is an open, blockchain-backed public network designed for fully automated end-to-end trading and execution of financial products. By leveraging decentralized technology, Vega aims to create a more transparent, efficient, and accessible financial system. This transformation is achieved through the elimination of intermediaries, enabling users to trade directly on the blockchain, thus reducing costs and increasing speed and security in financial transactions.

What types of financial products can be traded on the Vega platform?

Vega Protocol supports a wide range of financial products, particularly focusing on derivatives trading. Users can trade various types of derivatives, including futures, options, and swaps. The platform is designed to accommodate both traditional financial instruments and innovative decentralized finance (DeFi) products, allowing for a diverse trading experience.

How does Vega ensure the security and integrity of trades on its platform?

Vega Protocol employs advanced blockchain technology to ensure the security and integrity of trades. The decentralized nature of the network means that all transactions are recorded on a public ledger, making them immutable and transparent. Additionally, the platform utilizes smart contracts to automate trade execution and settlement, reducing the risk of human error and fraud. Regular audits and community governance further enhance the security measures in place.

Who can use the Vega Protocol, and what industries does it support?

Vega Protocol is designed for a wide range of users, including individual traders, institutional investors, and developers. It supports various industries such as finance, technology, and trading. By providing a decentralized trading platform, Vega enables participants from different sectors to engage in trading activities, fostering innovation and collaboration across the financial ecosystem.

What are the benefits of using a decentralized trading platform like Vega?

Using a decentralized trading platform like Vega offers several benefits, including lower trading fees, increased transparency, and enhanced control over assets. Users can trade directly on the blockchain without intermediaries, which reduces costs and speeds up transactions. Additionally, the transparent nature of blockchain technology allows users to verify trades and market data in real-time, fostering trust and confidence in the trading process.

How can developers integrate with the Vega Protocol?

Developers can integrate with Vega Protocol by utilizing its open-source software development kit (SDK) and APIs. The platform provides comprehensive documentation and resources to assist developers in building applications and services that leverage Vega's trading capabilities. By integrating with Vega, developers can create innovative financial products and contribute to the growing ecosystem of decentralized finance.

About EcoPlex
-------------

The InterNational Environmental Complex, or "EcoPlex," will be the premier environmental destination of the future. Under one roof, EcoPlex will house the nation’s first environmental museum, a national research accelerator, and offices for corporate sustainability departments and environmental NGOs. It will be an industry clearinghouse to promote societal and industrial resilience. It will also house the EcoLeaders Institute, a training center to cultivate the next generation of sustainability leaders. The state-of-the-art facility will be a national hub for innovation and accelerators.  
  
EcoPlex believes that sustainability can only be achieved by combining the interests of people, planet, profit, and peace. Current environmental efforts are siloed among the youth, NGOs, political leaders, corporations, and investors. By bringing all these stakeholders under one roof, EcoPlex will allow for true, streamlined collaboration. EcoPlex will facilitate speeding up technological design and funding, thereby delivering innovative and sensible solutions at an accelerated pace.  
  
The facility will be designed to showcase next-generation construction technologies. Furthermore, by hosting an interactive museum, the public and business leaders will be attracted to the complex as part of a living, experiential exhibit, leaving with ideas to enhance ROI and industrial resiliency. In a time of environmental crisis, EcoPlex offers a first-of-its-kind solution.  
  
The combination of policymakers, industry heavyweights, and environmental thought leaders will deliver much-needed strategies to mitigate environmental degradation and return the world to a healthy place.  
Earth is our collective home, and we all have a responsibility to use our resources wisely and responsibly. EcoPlex will accelerate a more resilient, sustainable, and smarter future.

You have been your own beauty product tester for years - let us take it from here. As skin care and data enthusiasts, we keenly feel the shortcomings of traditional ways of beauty product discovery - word of mouth, reviews from other buyers, etc. They fail to account for the uniqueness of each person's skin and fully ignores the valuable data contained in one's past product usage. As a response, we built Piqed. Users of the app receive skin care and beauty product recommendations tailored for them, based on their reactions to products they have used in the past. We save users the trouble and costliness of trial-and-error product experimentation and help them avoid potentially sensitive/harmful ingredients.

About Dashdoc
-------------

Dashdoc was created in September 2017 by Benoit Joncquez, Corentin Smith, Paul-Hubert des Minières and Arthur Ouaki with the objective of becoming the first SaaS road transport software system in France. In 2017, we sold our first app, Truckfly to Michelin in order to invest in Dashdoc. It then had over 100k MAU.  
  
At Dashdoc, we believe that having better access to the transport data from the transport order to the billing is a basic need. Because it is a professional challenge and a poorly digitalized sector, it should be super simple and user-friendly.  
  
We challenge the actual solutions by crafting beautifully designed tools that help our users to gather all road transport orders data, take the right decisions and share it with other stakeholders, with minimal effort.  
  
Focused on user-experience, Dashdoc centralizes all data and automatize all processes from a transport order from the shipping order until the billing. We help our customers order faster, access information better, bill faster and share all information.

What types of items can I buy, sell, or swap on Paperclip.co?

On Paperclip.co, you can buy, sell, or swap a wide variety of items, including electronics, clothing, furniture, home goods, toys, and more. The platform encourages users to list unloved items they no longer need, making it a great place to find unique second-hand goods or swap items with others in your local community.

How does the swapping process work on Paperclip.co?

Swapping on Paperclip.co is simple and user-friendly. First, you can browse items listed by other users in your area. If you find something you'd like to swap for, you can make an offer by proposing an item from your own collection. Once both parties agree on the swap, you can arrange a convenient time and place to exchange the items. The platform promotes local exchanges to foster community connections.

Is there a fee to use Paperclip.co for buying, selling, or swapping items?

No, Paperclip.co is completely free to use. You can list items for sale, make offers to buy, or propose swaps without any fees. The platform aims to create an accessible marketplace for everyone, allowing users to declutter their homes and find new treasures without financial barriers.

How can I ensure a safe transaction when using Paperclip.co?

Safety is a priority on Paperclip.co. We recommend meeting in public places for exchanges and bringing a friend along if possible. Always communicate through the platform’s messaging system to keep your personal information secure. Additionally, check user profiles and ratings to ensure you are dealing with trustworthy individuals. If you encounter any issues, our support team is available to assist you.

Can I use Paperclip.co on my desktop, or is it only available on mobile devices?

Paperclip.co is available on multiple platforms, including iPhone, Android, and desktop. You can access the marketplace from your computer or mobile device, making it easy to buy, sell, or swap items whenever and wherever you prefer.

What should I do if I encounter a problem with a transaction on Paperclip.co?

If you experience any issues during a transaction, such as a dispute with another user or a problem with an item, you can reach out to our support team through the help section of the website or app. We are committed to resolving issues promptly and ensuring a positive experience for all users. Additionally, we encourage users to leave feedback and ratings to help maintain a trustworthy marketplace.

About David MBA

As the President & CEO of Gilman Cheese, David MBA brings a wealth of experience and a strategic vision that has propelled the company to new heights in the food manufacturing sector. With a career spanning over two decades, David has honed his expertise in supply chain operations, product development, and financial management, making him a pivotal figure in the cheese industry. Under his leadership, Gilman Cheese has not only maintained its reputation for producing premium quality, shelf-stable processed cheese but has also embraced innovation to meet the evolving demands of the market.  
  
David's commitment to ethical leadership is evident in his approach to empowering teams and fostering a culture of transparency and accountability. About Biometrics For ECommerce
------------------------------

Steve Cook is an independent biometrics and fintech consultant with over five years in the biometrics industry specialising in digital identity and authentication.  
  
I advise banks, e-commerce enterprises, fintech start-ups and investor groups on how to implement their biometric strategy with choosing the right biometric partners and solutions.  
  
Please contact me if your organisation needs help in the deployment of biometrics.  
  
Banks face many challenges navigating through the diverse world of biometrics as well as meeting compliance with PSD2 and Strong Customer Authentication.  
  
I have expert knowledge in this area because it is a complex field with so many different products, models and approaches from established vendors to the new fintech start-ups. Therefore what is your criteria?  
  
\-Do you choose on-device, cloud base or on premise server matching and deployment?  
\-Which biometrics do you want your customers to use; Fingerprint, Face, Voice, Iris, Palm, Signutare, Behavioural?  
\-Do you choose an Annual Software Agreement, a SaaS model or an Enterprise License?  
\-What kind of terms and license do you require; Per User Per Year or Transaction based?  
\-What kind of technical support do you need?  
  
It can be very daunting just filtering through all the different products and selecting the right vendor that fits your requirements perfectly.  
  
Many Biometric experts will say there is not one size that fits all. This is very true. So I am here to help.  
  
I have a strong background in biometrics and I have established high level contacts in financial services. I have a very good understanding of the biometric markets and trends. I previously worked for organisations such as Daon and Facebanx,  
  
I am a regular speaker at biometric, fintech and payment conferences.  
  
Biometrics for eCommerce is a LinkedIn community and news group with more than 23,000 members. Please feel free to join the group at the link below.  
  
Please contact me at my LinkedIn page for further information.

About Hsiao-Yu Fish Tung

Hsiao-Yu Fish Tung is a dedicated Research Engineer at Google DeepMind, where he is at the forefront of advancing artificial intelligence through innovative research in 3D perception and common sense learning. His work focuses on enhancing the capabilities of embodied agents, enabling them to better perceive and interact with their environments. By leveraging self-supervised learning techniques, Hsiao-Yu explores how machines can autonomously improve their understanding of 3D spaces, which is crucial for applications in robotics and autonomous systems.  
  
Currently, Hsiao-Yu is involved in key projects that integrate multimodal large language models (LLMs) with advanced scene understanding and physics simulation. His expertise in machine learning and computer vision allows him to develop algorithms that not only enhance visual perception but also enable machines to reason and understand language contextually. This intersection of 3D perception and common sense reasoning is pivotal in creating intelligent agents that can navigate complex environments and perform tasks with a level of autonomy and adaptability previously thought unattainable.  
  
With a strong foundation in programming languages such as Python and C, along with proficiency in statistical modeling and machine learning frameworks, Hsiao-Yu is well-equipped to tackle the challenges of modern AI research. His skills in Matlab and Java further complement his ability to design and implement robust solutions for real-world applications. As he continues to push the boundaries of what is possible in AI, Hsiao-Yu's contributions are set to redefine how machines perceive and interact with the world around them.

In his current role, Brian leverages his combat experience and over 8,000 flight hours to mentor and guide junior personnel, enhancing their skills in flight operations, safety programs, and Crew Resource Management (CRM). About Oregon Department of Energy
---------------------------------

Our Vision:  
  
A safe, equitable, clean, and sustainable future.  
  
Our Mission:  
  
The Oregon Department of Energy helps Oregonians make informed decisions and maintain a resilient and affordable energy system. We advance solutions to shape an equitable clean energy transition, protect the environment and public health, and responsibly balance energy needs and impacts for current and future generations.  
  
On behalf of Oregonians across the state, the Oregon Department of Energy achieves its mission by providing:  
  
\- A Central Repository of Energy Data, Information, and Analysis: We research, collect, and analyze data and information to inform state energy planning, regulation, program administration, and policy development.  
\- A Venue for Problem-Solving Oregon's Energy Challenges: We convene constructive conversations about Oregon's energy challenges and opportunities that consider a diverse range of perspectives, foster collaboration and innovative solutions, and facilitate the sharing of best practices with consumers and stakeholders.  
\- Energy Education and Technical Assistance: We provide technical assistance, educational resources, and advice to support policy makers, local governments, industry, energy stakeholders, and the general public in solving energy challenges and meeting Oregon's energy, economic, and climate goals.  
\- Regulation and Oversight: We manage the responsible siting of energy facilities in the state, regulate the transport and disposal of radioactive materials, and represent Oregon's interests at the Hanford Nuclear Site.  
\- Energy Programs and Activities: We manage and administer statutorily authorized energy programs to save energy, support the state's decarbonization efforts, make communities more resilient, and position Oregon to lead by example.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Oregon Department of Energy

Who are the decision makers in Oregon Department of Energy?

The decision makers in Oregon Department of Energy are [Janine Benner](https://contactout.com/Janine-Benner-1085817)
, Jennifer Kalez, Rachel W, etc. Click to Find [Oregon Department of Energy decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Oregon%20Department%20of%20Energy&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What services does the Oregon Department of Energy provide to support renewable energy projects?

The Oregon Department of Energy (ODOE) offers a variety of services to support renewable energy projects, including technical assistance, funding opportunities, and guidance on energy policy. We help project developers navigate the permitting process, provide information on state and federal incentives, and connect them with resources for energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives. Our goal is to facilitate the development of clean energy solutions that align with Oregon's commitment to a sustainable future.

How can I access funding for energy efficiency improvements in my home or business?

Oregon residents and businesses can access funding for energy efficiency improvements through various programs administered by the ODOE. These programs may include grants, loans, and rebates for energy-saving upgrades such as insulation, heating and cooling systems, and renewable energy installations. To find specific funding opportunities, visit our website or contact our office for personalized assistance based on your needs and location.

What role does the Oregon Department of Energy play in energy policy development?

The Oregon Department of Energy plays a crucial role in shaping energy policy at the state level. We conduct research and analysis to inform policymakers, engage with stakeholders to gather input on energy issues, and develop recommendations for legislation and regulations that promote sustainability and energy efficiency. Our efforts aim to create a balanced energy system that meets the needs of Oregonians while addressing environmental concerns.

What resources are available for businesses looking to improve their energy efficiency?

Businesses in Oregon can access a range of resources to improve their energy efficiency, including technical assistance, workshops, and financial incentives. The ODOE provides information on best practices for energy management, energy audits, and case studies of successful projects. Additionally, we collaborate with local utilities and organizations to offer programs that support businesses in reducing energy consumption and costs while enhancing their sustainability efforts.

How does the Oregon Department of Energy support the cleanup of the Hanford Nuclear Site?

The Oregon Department of Energy is actively involved in the oversight and monitoring of the Hanford Nuclear Site cleanup process. We work in partnership with federal and state agencies to ensure that cleanup efforts are conducted safely and effectively, protecting public health and the environment. Our role includes providing technical expertise, participating in public meetings, and advocating for transparency and accountability in the cleanup process.

What initiatives does the Oregon Department of Energy have for promoting sustainability in communities?

The Oregon Department of Energy promotes sustainability in communities through various initiatives aimed at enhancing energy efficiency, supporting renewable energy projects, and fostering public engagement. We provide grants and technical assistance for community-based sustainability projects, facilitate partnerships between local governments and organizations, and offer educational resources to help residents make informed energy choices. Our initiatives are designed to empower communities to achieve their sustainability goals and contribute to a cleaner, more resilient energy future.

-------------------------------------------------](javascript:;)

*   [Profile](https://contactout.com/company/BioLum-Sciences-99212)
    
*   [Email Format](https://contactout.com/company/BioLum-Sciences-email-format-99212)
    

About BioLum Sciences
---------------------

BioLum Sciences specializes in bioanalytical chemistry for reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) centered around our core analysis platform and chemiluminescent assays. BioLum's technology measures biomarkers in exhaled breath condensate, blood, and other samples, empowering pharmaceutical developers and clinicians with tools to develop and personalize treatments for cardiovascular disease, asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), and others.  
  
We currently offer novel, highly selective chemiluminescent research kits for NO (nitric oxide) and ONOO- (peroxynitrite) for drug discovery and efficacy testing. We also provide R&D services in assay development, compound analysis, and specific analyte measurements, with an emphasis on oxidative stress and nitric oxide signaling.  
  
With the advent of biomarker analysis for monitoring disease severity and progression, there is a desire to shift towards remote patient monitoring via non-invasive biomarkers to improve treatment plans and lower overall costs on the healthcare system. Our initial programs are focused on cardiovascular disease, asthma, and copd.  
  
Our blood analysis product measures NO (nitric oxide) in the blood using a finger-prick test. This point-of-care test will provide physicians, researchers, and patients a critical gauge of endothelial dysfunction and cardiovascular health.  
  
Our breath analysis product, the BioSense AMD (Airway Monitoring Device) for H2O2 (hydrogen peroxide), provides a ‘window into the lung’ by measuring oxidative stress in exhaled breath condensate (EBC). Our test requires no complicated breathing maneuvers, allowing reliable at-home monitoring. Frequent, objective measurements of lung function offer significant patient benefits, allow physicians to optimize treatment, and enable researchers to stratify patients to better understand respiratory disease states.

About CAE USA
-------------

CAE USA, located in Tampa Florida, provides modeling and simulation technologies, integrated training solutions and training system support services for various defense and government agencies in the USA, Central and South America. CAE USA provides blended training solutions, fully integrated simulation products, and training services and curriculum that are capable of meeting military customers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) training requirements.  
  
CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness. CAE USA, located in Tampa Florida, is part of CAE's Defense and Security business unit with specific responsibility for serving the United States, South America and select international markets. CAE USA includes over 1,000 employees and is the largest segment within CAE's Defense and Security business unit. The organization leverages the full breadth of CAE's capabilities, technologies and solutions and provides simulation products, training services and training centers that contribute to the preparedness and readiness of United States and allied warfighters.  
  
CAE USA is a U.S. corporation that operates under a Special Security Agreement (SSA) with the U.S. Department of Defense. As a U.S. corporation operating under an SSA, CAE USA has its own U.S. board of directors that monitors and oversees all company activities related to classified and export-controlled information, security procedures, and company management. The President and General Manager of CAE USA reports directly to the CAE USA Board of Directors.

Anatolia Tile + Stone, a source for ceramic and stone products, is a leading brand and supplier to some of the largest distributors and national DIY chains throughout the United States and Canada, and expanding globally. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, in a 900,000 sq ft facility with offices and facilities across the globe totalling close to 5 million sq ft / 465,000 m2, Anatolia provides its partnering distributors access to an extensive, stable inventory as well as superior customer service beyond the industry norm. First recognized by Deloitte in 2008 as one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies, Anatolia has been awarded again for past three years for its outstanding business performance and sustained growth with the prestigious Canada’s Best Managed Companies designation.  
  
Anatolia Capital Corp. is a renewable energy and real estate management company that specializes in the management of commercial properties in Toronto and its surrounding areas. With its recent success in the market, Anatolia Capital Corp. continues to experience exceptional growth with new acquisitions in commercial properties and land for future development. Current holdings include over 4 million square feet of A Class industrial properties which are leased out. A portion of this is being used for our operations. Anatolia also owns over 2,000 acres of land for future industrial and residential development.  
  
Since the implementation of the Green Energy Act, Anatolia Capital Corp. has demonstrated a keen interest in renewable energy by investing in the Feed-In Tariff (FIT) program offered by the Ontario Power Authority (OPA). Currently, Anatolia Tile + Stone has one of the largest rooftop solar panel projects in Ontario with a 500 kW system that has been generating clean, renewable power since 2011. The success of this investment has spurred our leadership to pursue numerous other renewable energy projects.

About Randall Esulto

Randall Esulto serves as the Director of Production, Video & Media at SAR Academy, where he leverages his extensive background in event and media production management to drive impactful visual storytelling and enhance the institution's outreach efforts. In this pivotal role, Randall is responsible for orchestrating a diverse range of video, photographic, and livestream productions that support the Marketing, Communications, and Development departments. His expertise in new media and digital content creation enables him to produce high-quality materials that resonate with the academy's community, effectively showcasing its mission and values.  
  
In addition to his production responsibilities, Randall is passionate about fostering the next generation of media creators. He leads multimedia instructional programs for middle school students, imparting essential skills in video and photographic production. This hands-on approach not only enriches the students' educational experience but also cultivates a creative environment where young minds can explore their potential in digital media. Randall's commitment to education extends to after-school programs, where he encourages students to engage with technology and storytelling in innovative ways.  
  
With a strong foundation in entrepreneurship and process improvement, Randall excels in team leadership and project management, ensuring that each production is executed seamlessly and on schedule. His proficiency with tools such as Adobe Creative Suite and his keen eye for detail make him a valuable asset to SAR Academy. As he continues to push the boundaries of multimedia production, Randall remains dedicated to enhancing the academy's narrative through compelling visual content that inspires and informs.

Her clinical research initiatives focus on evidence-based practices that promote long-term health outcomes, ensuring that her patients receive the highest standard of care. Milkhaus is a full service production company located in Denver, Colorado. We specialize in documentaries, branded content, campaigns & non-profit programs, plus graphics & animation.  
  
We work with agencies, production companies, indy producers/filmmakers, non-profits, government agencies, museums, and small/large businesses directly in virtually any capacity. Whether we are brought in from the beginning or need to provide a la carte services as needed we have the talent and tools available.  
  
We focus on making stories work in any format the project might come in. The story is the meat and potatoes of any project. Once the story arc is solid, we add in the bells and whistles to make each project superior in quality.  
  
Our shop has a solid track record of very successful and award winning projects, including an Academy Award in 2012. We have broadcast in over 25 countries on HBO, BBC, Discovery, PBS, Channel 4, NBC, and many more. We have screened in theaters and festivals across the globe such as Sundance, Toronto, SXSW, Sheffield DocFest, HotDocs, PiFan, and Edinburgh.  
  
Stop by sometime to get a sense of who we are and how we can help you with your project.

About Synoptik

Et godt syn er afgørende for vores muligheder for at lære, opleve verden, bidrage til samfundet og i det hele taget skabe os et godt liv. Vi er fascinerede af, hvad et godt syn betyder for livskvaliteten og af, hvad velvalgt design kan gøre for den personlige fremtoning.  
  
Vi lever for sandhedens øjeblik. Når vi i butikken finder det perfekte par briller og de helt rigtige kontaktlinser, eller når vi via Synoptik Fonden er med til at hjælpe med et godt syn igennem hele livet. Og uden for Danmark hjælper vi medmennesker i Ghana. Her udleverer vi hvert år tusindvis af briller fra vores optikerklinik og giver dermed mange mennesker muligheden for at se skarpt for allerførste gang i livet.  
  
Det er i det øjeblik, hvor alting falder på plads, vi ved, at vi har gjort en synlig forskel.

What types of vision correction solutions does Synoptik offer?

Synoptik provides a wide range of vision correction solutions, including prescription glasses, contact lenses, and specialized lenses for various visual impairments. Our offerings include single vision, bifocal, and progressive lenses, as well as options for blue light filtering and photochromic lenses that adapt to changing light conditions.

How can I schedule an eye examination at Synoptik?

Scheduling an eye examination at Synoptik is easy. You can book an appointment online through our website or by visiting one of our stores. Our trained optometrists will conduct a comprehensive eye exam to assess your vision and eye health, ensuring you receive the best possible care tailored to your needs.

Does Synoptik offer solutions for children’s vision needs?

Yes, Synoptik is committed to supporting children's vision needs. We offer a range of pediatric eye care services, including eye examinations specifically designed for children. Our selection of stylish and durable children's glasses ensures that young ones can enjoy clear vision while looking good.

What industries does Synoptik serve with its vision solutions?

Synoptik serves a variety of industries, including healthcare, education, and corporate sectors. We provide tailored vision solutions for professionals who require optimal visual performance in their work environments. Our services also extend to organizations looking to promote eye health and wellness among their employees.

Are there any special promotions or discounts available at Synoptik?

What should I do if I have a problem with my glasses or contact lenses purchased from Synoptik?

If you experience any issues with your glasses or contact lenses purchased from Synoptik, we encourage you to visit the store where you made your purchase or contact our customer service team. Moreover, G-CON’s patent portfolio continues to grow which will effectively preclude imitators from copying G-CON’s initial and more recent innovations.

AQUA Engineering (AQUA) is a civil engineering firm specializing in municipal engineering, water resources, water and wastewater treatment design, and environmental services. As one of the region's leading civil engineering firms, AQUA delivers cost-effective, innovative solutions from master planning and feasibility studies to complete engineering, design and construction services for water and wastewater facilities, our extensive experience is enhanced by our deep understanding of and our commitment to the communities in which we live, work and play.  
  
AQUA’s principal engineers (Scott Rogers, Brad Rasmussen, Justin Logan, Darin Hawkes, Bob Frachetti, and Boris Petkovic) take a hands-on approach in overseeing projects from initial planning and funding through final design and construction to ensure our work is finished on time, within budget, and complies with the highest standards. Our approach to water and wastewater treatment design involves a comprehensive assessment of the specific needs of each project. We utilize state-of-the-art technologies and sustainable practices to create efficient, cost-effective treatment systems that meet regulatory requirements and serve the community's needs.

What industries does AQUA Engineering support?

AQUA Engineering supports various industries including municipal governments, environmental agencies, and private sector clients. Our expertise in water resources and treatment solutions makes us a valuable partner for projects related to urban development, infrastructure improvement, and environmental sustainability.

Where are AQUA Engineering's offices located?

About North Mississippi State Hospital
--------------------------------------

The Mississippi State Legislature through House Bill 960 passed in its 1995 session the enabling legislation authorizing the construction of a regional psychiatric hospital. The 50-bed acute care facility, located in Tupelo, Mississippi, offers treatment and services for mentally ill adult men and women in the northeastern portion of the state. North Mississippi State Hospital is the eleventh facility in the Department of Mental Health, joining five regional centers for individuals with developmental disabilities, one juvenile rehabilitation center, three other psychiatric hospitals, and a residential center for the mentally ill.  
  
The State of Mississippi through the Department of Mental Health is seeking to offer a continuum of services for the mentally ill within the patient's region of residence. This closer proximity will allow family, friends, and community to more actively support the treatment, recovery, and aftercare of the patient.  
  
North Mississippi State Hospital opened in April 1999. The hospital is located on the corner of Eason Boulevard and Briar Ridge Road and employs approximately 120 people.  
  
A groundbreaking ceremony was held on Thursday, December 19, 1996, signifying the first state-run psychiatric hospital to be established in Mississippi in more than a century.  
  
The patient's length of stay is intended to be 14-21 days. Emphasis is placed on a total continuum of care, including pre-admission, inpatient, aftercare, and crisis intervention. It is our goal to be a part of the community mental healthcare system and to work cooperatively with other service providers in positively influencing outcomes and the overall care of our patients.

About Prophet Samuel

Prophet Samuel is a prominent figure in the Abrahamic religions, particularly in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. He is revered as a prophet, judge, and leader who played a crucial role in the history of ancient Israel. Samuel's story is found in the books of 1 Samuel and 2 Samuel in the Hebrew Bible, and he is also mentioned in the Quran.  
  
Samuel's story begins with his mother, Hannah, who was barren and prayed to God for a child. Her prayers were answered, and she dedicated her son to God, bringing him to the tabernacle at Shiloh to serve under the priest Eli. It was there that Samuel first heard the voice of God calling out to him, setting him on the path to becoming a prophet.  
  
As a prophet, Samuel had a significant impact on the history of Israel. He anointed the first two kings of Israel, Saul and David, and played a crucial role in the transition from the period of the judges to the establishment of the monarchy. Samuel's authority as a prophet and judge was widely respected, and he was known for his unwavering dedication to God and his commitment to upholding justice and righteousness.  
  
One of the most well-known stories involving Samuel is the anointing of David as king. When Saul, the first king of Israel, fell out of favor with God, Samuel was sent by God to anoint a new king from the house of Jesse. After going through all of Jesse's sons, Samuel finally found the one chosen by God, the youngest son, David. This marked a pivotal moment in the history of Israel, as David would go on to become one of the greatest kings of Israel and the ancestor of Jesus in Christian belief.  
  
Samuel's role as a judge and leader is also highlighted in the story of the Israelites' demand for a king. Samuel warned the people of the consequences of having a king, but they insisted, and God directed Samuel to anoint Saul as their first king. However, Saul's disobedience to God led to the eventual rejection of his kingship, and Samuel played a crucial role in ensuring the transition to David as the new king.  
  
Throughout his life, Samuel remained dedicated to serving God and guiding the people of Israel. He was known for his integrity, wisdom, and prophetic insight, and he was a central figure in the religious and political life of ancient Israel. His legacy as a prophet and leader continues to be celebrated in the traditions of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, where he is remembered as a model of faith and devotion to God.  
  
In the Islamic tradition, Samuel (known as Shamuel in Arabic) is also revered as a prophet, and his story is mentioned in the Quran. He is regarded as a righteous and wise figure who guided the people of Israel and called them to worship and obey God. His role as a prophet and leader aligns with the teachings of Islam, which emphasize the importance of following the guidance of the prophets and living a life of piety and righteousness.  
  
Overall, the story of Prophet Samuel is one of faith, leadership, and devotion to God. His life and teachings continue to inspire believers of different faiths, and his legacy as a prophet and leader remains an integral part of the religious and cultural heritage of the Abrahamic traditions. Prophet Samuel's story serves as a reminder of the importance of following God's guidance, upholding justice, and remaining steadfast in faith, even in the face of adversity.

He died, and his ghost was evoked by a necromancer, or sorceress, at the request of Saul; he then announced a third time the rejection of Saul (chapter 28).

One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place. The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was. Then the LORD called Samuel. Samuel answered, "Here I am."

Animées d'une volonté d'innovation, nos équipes unissent leur savoir-faire pour proposer les solutions créatives les plus adaptées et efficientes. Afin de rester maître de la chaîne digitale, notre activité est structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertise :

\- Cloud, pour héberger avec un accès simplifié et des économies budgétaires dans une solution sécurisée et efficace.  
  
Conscients de l’évolution permanente du digital, nous repérons les dernières tendances et assimilons de nouvelles compétences afin de rester un partenaire digne de confiance et leader de ses expertises.  
Quel que soit votre projet, Actimage vous propose un accompagnement sur-mesure pour réussir ensemble la transformation vers un monde à votre image.

How can Tax Goddess assist with IRS negotiations and debt settlements?

Tax Goddess has extensive experience in dealing with IRS negotiations and debt settlements. Forming an LLC or corporation with Tax Goddess is a streamlined process. First, we conduct a consultation to understand your business goals and structure preferences. We also provide guidance on obtaining an EIN, setting up your bookkeeping system, and ensuring compliance with ongoing requirements. Our goal is to make the process as smooth as possible for you.

How does Tax Goddess approach bookkeeping for small businesses?

At Tax Goddess, we understand that bookkeeping is a crucial aspect of running a small business. Our approach involves providing customized bookkeeping solutions that fit your specific needs. We offer services such as transaction recording, financial reporting, and monthly reconciliations. Our team ensures that your financial records are accurate and up-to-date, enabling you to make informed business decisions and maintain compliance with tax regulations.

About Willem C. Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot
-------------------------------------------------------------

The purpose of the Vis Moot is to foster the study of international commercial law and arbitration and provide a practical training to students for resolving international business disputes. The business community’s marked preference for resolving international commercial disputes by arbitration is the reason this method of dispute resolution was selected as the clinical tool to train law students.  
  
There are two crucial phases in the Vis Moot to train advocacy skills: the writing of memoranda for claimant and respondent and the presentation of arguments in oral hearings held before arbitration practitioners and academics. The forensic and written exercises require determining questions of contract — flowing from a transaction relating to the sale or purchase of goods under the United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods and other uniform international commercial law.  
  
The dispute is resolved in the context of an arbitration under specified Arbitration Rules. In the pairings of teams for each general round, every effort is made to have civil law schools argue against common law schools — so each may learn from approaches taken by persons trained in another legal culture. Similarly, the teams of arbitrators judging each round are from both common law and civil law backgrounds.

.

What types of connectors does I-PEX manufacture?

I-PEX specializes in a wide range of connectors, including RF connectors, micro coaxial connectors, and high-speed connectors. These products are designed for various applications in telecommunications, consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial sectors, ensuring high signal integrity and performance in demanding environments.

How does I-PEX ensure the quality of its products?

I-PEX employs an ultra-precision manufacturing process that includes rigorous quality control measures at every stage of production. This includes advanced testing for signal integrity, EMI performance, and durability. Our commitment to quality is reflected in our certifications and adherence to international standards, ensuring that our products meet the highest industry requirements.

What industries does I-PEX serve?

I-PEX serves a diverse range of industries, including telecommunications, automotive, medical devices, consumer electronics, and industrial automation. Our solutions are tailored to meet the specific needs of each sector, providing innovative and reliable connectivity solutions that enhance performance and efficiency.

Can I-PEX provide custom solutions for specific applications?

Yes, I-PEX offers custom design and manufacturing services to meet the unique requirements of our clients. Our experienced engineering team collaborates closely with customers to develop tailored solutions, whether it involves specialized connectors, sensors, or molded parts. We leverage our expertise in mechanical design and manufacturing to deliver high-quality, customized products.

What is the significance of signal integrity in I-PEX products?

Signal integrity is crucial for the performance of high-speed and high-frequency applications. I-PEX designs its connectors and components to minimize signal loss and interference, ensuring reliable data transmission. Our focus on maintaining signal integrity helps our clients achieve optimal performance in their electronic systems, particularly in applications like telecommunications and data centers.

What are the advantages of using I-PEX's micro coaxial connectors?

I-PEX's micro coaxial connectors are designed for high-density applications where space is limited. They offer excellent performance in terms of signal integrity and EMI shielding, making them ideal for use in advanced telecommunications and consumer electronics. The compact design and high-frequency capabilities of these connectors enable efficient and reliable connections in challenging environments.

About Chappie James

Chappie James was an extraordinary fighter pilot who broke through racial barriers to become the first African-American four-star general in the United States Air Force. Born in Pensacola, Florida in 1920, he grew up in a segregated society where opportunities for African Americans were limited. Despite facing discrimination, James was determined to pursue his dream of flying and joined the Tuskegee Airmen, an all-black military pilot group during World War II.  
  
In the face of adversity, James excelled in his training and combat missions, earning numerous honors and distinctions for his exceptional flying skills and courage. After the war, he continued to serve in various leadership positions, eventually rising to the rank of general. Throughout his military career, James broke down racial barriers and paved the way for future generations of African American pilots and leaders.

What services does Corsearch offer for trademark protection?

Corsearch provides a comprehensive suite of services designed to help businesses protect their trademarks and brands. This includes trademark screening to identify potential conflicts, trademark watching to monitor for unauthorized use, and trademark research to ensure thorough due diligence. Additionally, Corsearch offers solutions for managing domain portfolios and mitigating domain infringement, ensuring that brands can safeguard their online presence effectively.

How does Corsearch utilize AI in its trademark solutions?

Corsearch leverages AI-powered data and analytics to enhance its trademark and brand protection solutions. By using advanced algorithms, Corsearch can quickly analyze vast amounts of trademark data, identify potential conflicts, and provide actionable insights to clients. This technology not only speeds up the trademark clearance process but also improves accuracy, helping businesses make informed decisions about their brand strategies.

Who can benefit from Corsearch's services?

Corsearch's services are designed for a wide range of clients, including corporations, law firms, and brand owners across various industries. Whether a company is launching a new product, expanding into new markets, or simply looking to protect its existing trademarks, Corsearch provides tailored solutions to meet their specific needs. With over 5,000 customers worldwide, Corsearch supports businesses of all sizes in effectively managing their trademark portfolios.

What is the Trademark Clearinghouse and how does Corsearch support it?

The Trademark Clearinghouse (TMCH) is a global database that helps brand owners protect their trademarks in the domain name system. Corsearch supports the TMCH by providing registration services that ensure trademarks are recorded and monitored effectively. This helps prevent domain name infringement and allows brand owners to take action against unauthorized use of their trademarks in new gTLDs (generic top-level domains).

Can Corsearch assist with global trademark clearance projects?

Yes, Corsearch specializes in global clearance project management. Their team of experts can guide businesses through the complexities of international trademark laws and regulations, ensuring that all necessary checks are conducted across multiple jurisdictions. This service is particularly beneficial for companies looking to expand their brand presence globally while minimizing the risk of trademark conflicts.

What industries does Corsearch serve?

Corsearch serves a diverse range of industries, including technology, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, entertainment, and more. We provide electrical, transportation, telecommunications and control system integration services. Our electrical division performs specialty electrical contracting work as well as design/build projects. Our transportation division performs all phases of underground network and traffic control technology. Our telecommunications division specializes in the installation of voice-data systems and DC power plants and cabling. About David Siska

David Siska is a distinguished Reader in Mathematics at The University of Edinburgh, where he combines his passion for teaching with cutting-edge research in mathematical finance, stochastic control, and machine learning. With a robust academic background, David delves into the theoretical underpinnings of stochastic partial differential equations and their applications in financial mathematics. His expertise not only enriches the curriculum but also equips students with the quantitative skills necessary for navigating complex financial landscapes.  
  
At Edinburgh, David teaches a range of courses, including Stochastic Control and Dynamic Asset Allocation, and Risk-Neutral Asset Pricing, at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. His teaching philosophy emphasizes the integration of theoretical concepts with practical applications, ensuring that students gain a comprehensive understanding of quantitative finance. By leveraging advanced techniques such as Monte Carlo simulations and finite difference methods, he prepares students to tackle real-world challenges in financial markets.  
  
In addition to his academic role, David is a key member of the founding team and serves as the lead quant at Vega, where he applies his research insights to develop innovative solutions in quantitative analytics. His work at Vega bridges the gap between academia and industry, allowing him to explore the practical implications of stochastic methods and interest rate swaps in financial modeling. David's unique blend of teaching, research, and industry experience positions him as a thought leader in the field, driving advancements in both mathematical theory and its applications in finance.

Mihir Mathur is a dynamic Product Manager at Tecton, where he is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge products that enable real-time AI decision-making for a diverse clientele, from innovative startups to Fortune 50 enterprises. These products are instrumental in powering mission-critical AI/ML applications at industry leaders like Coinbase and Block, showcasing his ability to deliver scalable solutions that drive intelligent decision-making.  
  
Prior to his role at Tecton, Mihir honed his skills at renowned organizations such as Lyft, Quora, Houzz, and Thomson Reuters, where he focused on building AI/ML-based products that impact millions of users. His passion for crafting beautiful and intelligent products is evident in his meticulous approach to product vision and road mapping, ensuring that user-centered design principles are at the core of every project. Mihir's proficiency in web development technologies, including HTML, CSS, and jQuery, complements his strong communication skills, allowing him to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.  
  
As he continues to push the boundaries of what's possible in real-time AI, Mihir remains committed to fostering innovation and enhancing user experiences. His work not only shapes the future of AI-driven products but also empowers organizations to harness the full potential of their data, ultimately transforming the landscape of intelligent decision-making across industries.

About Rescop
------------

Rescop offers a unique combination of GxP compliance software and services, to enable regulated companies to work in a lean and paperless way and increase the maturity of their organization and their processes. Based on this combination of software and services, Rescop is a one-stop global provider of GxP compliance solutions and support.  
  
The next generation compliance and quality management software of Rescop, bundled in the integrated software suite RC-QMS, incorporates Rescop's knowledge and practical experience in quality, validation and information technology. This provides the greatest benefit to customers in their efforts to establish and maintain compliance and ensure inspection readiness. The RC-QMS suite includes products for system life cycle management (icl. commissioning, qualification and validation), which are used by companies like Merck and Johnson & Johnson.  
  
Besides its configurable off-the-shelf software products, Rescop also offers custom software development services globally in accordance with its GxP and GAMP 5.0 compliant QMS.  
  
The GxP compliance services provided globally by Rescop include Quality and Process Management, Qualification and Validation Services, Quality Engineering, IT Delivery and Support, and IT Demand and Process Improvement.  
  
We have extensive experience with setting up and implementating corporate policies, procedures and work instructions for computerized system validation globally, and assessing existing corporate quality management systems and improving them accordingly.  
  
We operate from our various offices globally and cover all continents.  
  
Rescop Academy can help you improve human behavior in environments subject to medical regulations. Rescop Academy has experienced trainers, who still work in practice, to help you increase the right knowledge at the right time.

Our dazzling selection of products includes the highest-quality prime, dry-aged meats; a carefully curated selection of fresh produce; chef-prepared foods and pastries made from scratch every day; artisanal cheeses; cured meats; smoked fish; and an exceptional collection of our own Citarella-brand olive oils, vinegars, pastas, sauces, and chocolates. We stay true to our roots by continuing to offer the most incredible variety of the freshest seafood available.

--------------------------

The Cato Corporation (Cato) is a women’s fashion specialty retailer. As of January 28, 2012, the Company operated 1,288 fashion specialty stores in 31 states, principally in the southeastern United States, under the names Cato, Cato Fashions, Cato Plus, It’s Fashion, It’s Fashion Metro and Versona Accessories. It operates in two segments: stores and Credit. The Company’s stores offer a assortment of on-trend apparel and accessory items in primarily junior/missy, plus sizes, girls sizes 7 to 16, men’s and kids sizes newborn to seven. Its merchandise lines include dressy, career, and casual sportswear, dresses, coats, shoes, lingerie, costume jewelry, handbags, men’s wear and lines for kids and newborns. Its merchandise is sold under its private label and is produced by various vendors in accordance with the Company’s specifications.

About 90.9 The Bridge
---------------------

Turn On. Tune In. Listen Local. The Bridge is listener-supported, non-commercial NPR music radio for Kansas City.  
  
In 2013, Kansas City PBS acquired the Triple-A (adult album alternative) radio station broadcasting out of Warrensburg, Missouri. While KTBG 90.9 moved down the road the 60-some miles from Warrensburg to Kansas City, the station’s passion for local music, community, and independent voices has remained the same.  
  
In fact, with the power of KCPT behind it, The Bridge has strengthened its commitment to weaving new, rare, and local music into all of our playlists, right alongside familiar hits and classics you know and love. The Bridge connects music lovers with music makers through performances and interviews. As KTBG 90.9, we’re out in the community, supporting the musicians, the venues, the listeners.  
  
Our website brings you local industry voices, breaking music news and national music news. No other station does what we do. And nobody else in town plays as much local music as The Bridge. Period.  
  
Our city is a true original. And so is The Bridge.

About Atticus
-------------

At any given time, 15 million Americans are experiencing a crisis that requires urgent help from our legal system or government. The right assistance could transform their lives. But today, most never get it. Atticus is a startup on a mission to change that.  
  
We're reinventing a broken space: the $100 billion market for legal services for individuals. We've taken a rare and exclusive commodity — access to expert legal advice and referrals — and made it free and available to everyone. To clients, we're a source of trusted guidance and an easy way to find and hire a great lawyer. To lawyers, we're a source of vetted clients and a way to build a practice they love while doing good. For now, most of our work involves helping disabled Americans qualify for government benefits. We also help victims of accidents, misconduct, and violence recover by getting compensation from insurance.  
  
We've raised $28 million from top VC firms like Forerunner (Jet, Glossier, Warby Parker) and True Ventures (Peloton, Fitbit, Ring) and helped thousands of people in need. Our team of 60 is growing fast, and we're seeking great people to help in our mission.

Jake Locker is a former American football quarterback who played college football at the University of Washington and went on to be a first-round draft pick in the 2011 NFL Draft. Locker was known for his athleticism, strong arm, and leadership on and off the field. He was a highly-touted high school player and went on to have a successful college career before entering the NFL.  
  
During his time at the University of Washington, Locker quickly established himself as a top quarterback prospect. He was a dual-threat quarterback who could make plays with his arm and his legs, and he quickly became a leader for the Huskies. In his sophomore season, Locker showed flashes of his potential, throwing for over 2,000 yards and rushing for over 900 yards. His junior year was even more impressive, as he led the Huskies to their first bowl game in almost a decade and was named the offensive MVP of the game.  
  
After his junior season, Locker had a choice to make: enter the NFL Draft or return for his senior year. Ultimately, he decided to return to school to continue his development and help lead the Huskies to a successful season. This decision not only showcased his dedication to the team, but also his strong leadership qualities. In his senior year, Locker improved his passing numbers and led the Huskies to another bowl game, solidifying his status as one of the top quarterback prospects in the draft.  
  
In the 2011 NFL Draft, Locker was selected eighth overall by the Tennessee Titans, making him the second quarterback taken in the draft behind Cam Newton. The Titans saw Locker as their quarterback of the future and hoped that he could develop into a franchise player for the team. Locker showed promise in his rookie season, starting a handful of games and making some impressive plays with his arm and his legs. However, injuries limited his playing time and hindered his development early in his career.  
  
Despite the setbacks, Locker continued to work hard and improve as a quarterback. In his third season, he became the Titans' full-time starter and showed flashes of his potential. He had some standout performances and earned the respect of his teammates and coaches for his work ethic and determination. However, injuries continued to plague Locker, and he was never able to stay healthy for a full season.  
  
In 2015, after four seasons with the Titans, Locker made the decision to retire from football. While injuries played a major role in his decision, Locker also cited a desire to spend more time with his family and pursue other interests outside of football. His retirement was met with disappointment from fans and teammates, as many believed that Locker had the potential to be a successful quarterback in the NFL.  
  
While his NFL career may have been cut short, Locker's impact on the game of football is still felt today. His athleticism and leadership qualities made him an exciting player to watch, and he continues to be remembered for his contributions to the sport. Although his time in the NFL was brief, Jake Locker will always be remembered as a talented quarterback who left a lasting impression on the game.

About Code Club
---------------

At Code Club, we think all children should have the opportunity to learn to code, no matter who they are or where they come from. We work with a global community of volunteers, educators, and partners to run free coding clubs where 9 to 13-year-olds build and share their ideas.  
  
We believe in learning through making, and our coding projects offer young people plenty of opportunities to be creative and to share their creations with each other.  
  
Code Club is part of the Raspberry Pi Foundation, a UK-based charity.  
  
Our projects are free and open to all. They are easy-to-follow, step-by-step guides that young people use to make their own games, animations, and websites with coding languages such as Scratch, HTML/CSS, and Python.  
  
The projects introduce coding concepts one by one and let young people progressively build their knowledge. Adults running the clubs don’t need to be experienced coders, and many volunteers in our community enjoy learning alongside their club members.  
  
We provide help and support to clubs and volunteers through online training, community events, and a help desk. We also offer lots of additional useful resources, such as downloadable certificates and posters, and we regularly run competitions and prize draws to keep our clubs inspired and connected.
