About Jake Luhrs

Jake Luhrs is an American musician best known as the lead vocalist for the metalcore band August Burns Red. Born on November 30, 1986, in Mount Joy, Pennsylvania, Jake has made a significant impact on the metal scene with his powerful vocals and emotionally charged performances. He is recognized for his intense stage presence and his ability to connect with audiences on a deep, personal level.  
  
Jake's journey as a musician began in his teenage years when he developed a passion for heavy music and was drawn to the expressive nature of hardcore and metalcore. He honed his skills as a vocalist and joined various local bands before ultimately finding his place in August Burns Red. The band gained widespread attention with their debut album, "Thrill Seeker," released in 2005, and quickly rose to prominence in the metalcore scene.  
  
As the frontman for August Burns Red, Jake has played a pivotal role in the band's success, contributing his raw, cathartic vocals to their powerful and intricate sound. His intense and emotive delivery has resonated with fans around the world, earning him a dedicated following. Whether performing on stage or in the recording studio, Jake brings a sense of urgency and vulnerability to his music, creating an immersive experience for listeners.  
  
Beyond his work with August Burns Red, Jake is also known for his advocacy in mental health and his commitment to helping those in need. He founded the nonprofit organization HeartSupport, which provides a community for individuals struggling with mental health issues, addiction, and trauma. Through HeartSupport, Jake has used his platform to raise awareness about mental health and to offer support and resources to those facing challenges. His openness about his own experiences with mental health has inspired and empowered countless individuals to seek help and find healing.  
  
In addition to his music and advocacy work, Jake is also a devout Christian and incorporates his faith into his art and his message. He is vocal about the positive impact that spirituality has had on his life and how it has influenced his approach to music and connecting with others. His authenticity and sincerity shine through in his lyrics and performances, inviting listeners to explore deeper themes of hope, perseverance, and personal growth.  
  
Jake Luhrs' dedication to his craft, his unwavering support for those struggling with mental health, and his commitment to sharing his faith have solidified his reputation as a respected and influential figure in the metalcore community. His passion for music and his willingness to address difficult and important topics have set him apart as an artist who is not afraid to bring depth and meaning to his work. Whether he's on stage, in the studio, or engaging with his fans, Jake's impact is felt far beyond the bounds of the music world, making him a truly remarkable and inspiring individual.

About Greater Houston Women's Chamber Of Commerce
-------------------------------------------------

The Greater Houston Women's Chamber of Commerce, now 1200+ member businesses strong, is a nonprofit organization of highly influential and diverse women and men dedicated to the advancement and empowerment of women through avenues of leadership, education, advocacy and mentoring. We are the platform for business women in the greater Houston region.  
  
Our Major Initiatives  
• Annual Houston Conference for Women, 2021s keynote speakers were Diane Von Furstenberg, Brooke Baldwin, Tyla-Simone Crayton, Tara Martin,  
• Greater Houston Women’s Hall of Fame, recognizing outstanding who have spent their lives giving back so we all have a better quality of life.  
• Women in the Fast Lane of STEAM, celebrating executive women and entrepreneurs in STEAM fields who are role models  
• LAUNCH , provides education, resources and tools for women-led businesses to be successful  
• Women on Board is a year-long institute providing the tools, relationships and resources for women to become board ready.  
• Education initiatives include STEAM Town USA encouraging 3rd grade girls to pursue STEAM careers, Love What You Do, a valuable job-shadowing program, an annual scholarship program providing deserving female high school students in six Houston area school districts a scholarship to attend the Texas college of their choice.  
  
As women who have succeeded in times when job opportunities for women were limited, we are still faced with challenges. This Chamber's success shows how we can do so much more. By becoming a united force for prosperity for all women, and by providing key scholarships to those with great promise, we are creating the future leaders of our community. We now enjoy a future where the sky is the limit. Women have shown they are creative thinkers capable of leading American business to work smarter, faster and become more competitive than ever before.  
  
See GHWCC.org for meetings and events with our Fort Bend County and North Houston Woodlands Chapters.

With over 25 years of extensive experience in strategic financial and operational roles across various industries, Todd has established himself as a collaborative business partner adept at navigating complex financial landscapes. His expertise spans aerospace and defense, automotive, artificial intelligence, healthcare, and manufacturing, making him a versatile leader in today's rapidly evolving market.  
  
At Teledyne FLIR, Todd oversees financial operations across more than 40 global locations, guiding the integration of FLIR's robust portfolio into Teledyne's operational framework. His leadership is pivotal in driving operational excellence and ensuring seamless financial reporting, particularly in the wake of the $8.2 billion acquisition, which significantly expanded Teledyne's capabilities in advanced sensing technologies. Todd's proficiency in mergers and acquisitions, coupled with his strong background in due diligence and treasury management, has been instrumental in aligning the financial strategies of both organizations.  
  
In addition to his financial acumen, Todd is committed to fostering a culture of organizational leadership and innovation within Teledyne FLIR. He leverages his skills in financial modeling to inform strategic decision-making and optimize resource allocation, ensuring that the company remains at the forefront of technological advancements. As the landscape of artificial intelligence continues to evolve, Todd's insights and strategic vision position Teledyne FLIR to capitalize on emerging opportunities, reinforcing its status as a leader in the industry.
